Peter, The State Department is looking more and more like a **Department of War **than a Department of Diplomacy. __**[I AGREE>>](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=a7b0d635158045909c4168f300b7def7&_e=jfK38EA4ZDoftb816CXa4TSitRAMk3x4Wf93dNu1EFaKnFlFgO_S9eIwHc8wcFcAYrrbMK1GeiFbSm-FV1nU6KnY80vvvaqA_xOV-tkXOjT-bYRFEQh_GckZy6O8ZdFWLBiSyRwZttwXYTHPBgD0WCq-DMyF73OQOGDR-Ap10V16Vl0MUU1Sd3SfmvjZXlcZmjelFsOvxH7-AXcwoZieydwnR_TNk4Q3kro9sb524ZmKFzu6O3OT9T8jjS2_GPiTbYiXg6_6I6-9ud9hCBFKjxRYuc1IRN8Y81uKO1xYxAzPb_p6j2v1MHczoZExfJQjxjVupxbi7zBP7ljoI5zi6FI_BJYMIlMPGu36X385i44nTTdPfzKu1wGTJT6vg_wI)**__ They’re quick to say we must get involved in every conflict around the world. And they launch us into never-ending wars without thinking about the repercussions, particularly when it comes boots on the ground. _Peter, the Biden administration should be negotiating to end the slaughter in Ukraine, but recent testimony from James O’Brien, the Assistant Secretary of State for European and Eurasian Affairs, shows that’s_** _NOT_** _the case._ **It’s time to send a message to the warmongers on both sides: [We are DONE with the never-ending wars that spiral our nation even further into debt and send our sons and daughters into harm’s way.](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=a7b0d635158045909c4168f300b7def7&_e=jfK38EA4ZDoftb816CXa4TSitRAMk3x4Wf93dNu1EFaKnFlFgO_S9eIwHc8wcFcAYrrbMK1GeiFbSm-FV1nU6KnY80vvvaqA_xOV-tkXOjT-bYRFEQh_GckZy6O8ZdFWLBiSyRwZttwXYTHPBgD0WCq-DMyF73OQOGDR-Ap10V16Vl0MUU1Sd3SfmvjZXlcZmjelFsOvxH7-AXcwoZieydeWWslp7Arf97GTBsqIBzQab9mu67gYZPv-p0rEnjeu9xWNZAIA5sB7WCmRO-IG8mAKreAHFOeJ_PX81HNiZ0bqrNnlwXr_va8bv-JekDAnPt1-ThTwn9GPVCt06AggmY_18gF_wJD-sHc0stoBRGq1cJqSQE6FlXgyX92NRwPD)**

Friend,

**Yes, we lost. We lost across the country in this year 's election. And it's not looking good for next year.

Patriots are losing -- radical Democrats are winning.

I never thought the day would come when I would type this email -- after all the Biden administration has done -- I thought we'd be a shoo-in for success this year.

| Peter,

# FROM THE DESK OF LARRY KUDLOW
---
| | Dear Fellow Conservative, **It wasn’t long ago that The New York Sun, one of my favorite papers, became the exclusive publisher of my columns. ****In the short time that’s passed, the Sun’s mission has become more urgent than ever.****

**It’s been obvious to many of us for some time that journalism in our country has become corrupted.

More dangerous than the ideological implication is the fact that we’re left with precious few to hold our country’s most powerful institutions to account. Our justice system, law enforcement, universities, major corporations and government agencies have become politicized beyond recognition and act with impunity.

**The Sun is brave and relentless**. Every day it tackles head-on the most important issues facing our country. It truly holds the powerful to account.

It acts as a true newspaper should, in the service of traditional American values and the American people.

The Sun has a long history leading the charge. Its commitment to the finest journalistic standards goes all the way back to its founding in 1833.

The Sun is now growing at a rapid pace, but we’re up against some of the world’s largest media conglomerates. **To win, we need you to join us**. Every single person counts.

| | | This week marks American Education Week, a commemoration started over 100 years ago to honor our public schools, and all of the people who keep them running. From school support staff, educators, librarians, crossing guards, to countless others, every school-based professional plays a role in providing our children with the environment they need for success.

**They work tirelessly to support our nation’s public schools and prepare our students for bright futures.** Join us in thanking the thousands of educators and staff across the country who make our public schools what they are.

**_[Sign our virtual thank you card today to show our gratitude for the hard work and dedication it takes to keep our schools and students safe and set for success.](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/P8Elou2Rvc0qoMPEUZrMXcOpy_XqN4R2ZGjoK-5zZnn42yJgVC062rlNsqdu_HaUHCENsBoc0he0r103gLM3m-ifjeBtLMEmsJHhYVWHMWn4qBvC8MWSGXmoUShgcUlusTb0WJOg-0lCVkgkv2OBiTdgmXJUXwcKapaZ3317dMgHRV0FgB02HLi6fxYr-9mWohHgIGj_2TlTEMHQdpMbFdA7jHg7gTKxzEgMYJdvqNA4PyJqnsWIyhDHS1cjaqYabUrDfUyE-FZT6PRugdeiwEUMXQlA1VzTdv0vqafzoKiQdMlMnxerFHxOxDZUsXGkmNLQIKafzcH5JxQaDDzBFw/41d/WG6kvvxHTAu7fBt4gL11VQ/h0/9RN0jQK1y9KDmnJbg-uzcJ1QPjdeufPXoboHPwFujqM)_**

Educators and school staff are critical to students' success both inside and outside of the classroom. They help provide the next generation with the tools they need to enter the world and make a difference.

However, it is not always easy for them. Under-funding and inequities in funding make educators' already challenging jobs all the more difficult.

That is why the work we do at Their Future PAC is so important. We know the challenges facing today’s students and educators in the public school system and are putting in the work to address them. With your support, we will fight against the inequities in our education system and work to protect our public education system that is currently under attack by the extreme right.

**_[Their Future PAC is committed to ensuring that all children have access to a high quality education. Sign here to let educators know that you support Safe, Just& Equitable Schools for their students.](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/P8Elou2Rvc0qoMPEUZrMXcOpy_XqN4R2ZGjoK-5zZnn42yJgVC062rlNsqdu_HaUHCENsBoc0he0r103gLM3m-ifjeBtLMEmsJHhYVWHMWn4qBvC8MWSGXmoUShgcUlusTb0WJOg-0lCVkgkv2OBiTdgmXJUXwcKapaZ3317dMiwTihyzGSv4TZ1Jq8XUhA2SFkBGeQAnR_J3AdhV48k4f5DnHC53FdHr3w1AVDfZ5s-CWu0tpFEaTC4IzzDeELEvUT3rsXYwVvasu9NXXGdEeAf-eeA56lWulsNtIMxx4I_3QTEoCpOA9mMIJKAW0qvO8lcVsuZg3vIgsMl4PbUOQ/41d/WG6kvvxHTAu7fBt4gL11VQ/h2/z5Ldresv-kI6_IRATV_G1FFiBfOXBjVaOSgTwo7uBrc)_**

The dedicated staff in our schools deserve our thanks year round–the least we can do is deliver them a thoughtful “thank you” card this week. To continue showing them our gratitude, it’s **crucial that we promote investment in education throughout the year, not just during American Education Week.**

Together, we can protect education as a fundamental human right for every child in this country.

Thank you,

Annie

body:
This is why we need to Drain the Swamp
| | [ ](http://links.fighttheswamp.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=165cd436408044259605c7e8b0ff18a6&_e=WbKNOZMwGpbZPRSxbupneST4oryxEMNrq_sHTrybx_r_tHJVRJ7q3tIV2OACD2bxCB-NaE_cTKrz7aGCp3x_yb7TGdETHo_BRdcP2pxEyfXcIPAflJ8wo33CYU5a7Vd6K55tCcSwLODDlL2Z7ADopuv676keoxNtCYqbdjeTMy3AsHXQRC_oZPQ6w4L7mqUGM9tWE2Mo3iOeiuQ5pqcUWx3z3zfYN_mhc0GWkUYaoakGPgyYATUPFvTak_BGTHi9T2ZS1XZeaIIhQoFrEuAZHlncjaYh5ekMSHUfAnY3elHBRGtoaNAvAjK9bXGNN7KFwQLnzza-quypNS_sOjPgSWg4wLjgJvRWL-ENALqifOk%3D)
---
Friend: Speaker Kevin McCarthy is livid, and he's showing us his true colors. Earlier this week, McCarthy turned to CNN to vent his frustrations about me in something similar to a therapy session. He went as far as saying how _**" the GOP would benefit tremendously if I wasn't around."**_
| [ ](http://links.fighttheswamp.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=165cd436408044259605c7e8b0ff18a6&_e=WbKNOZMwGpbZPRSxbupneST4oryxEMNrq_sHTrybx_r_tHJVRJ7q3tIV2OACD2bxCB-NaE_cTKrz7aGCp3x_yb7TGdETHo_BRdcP2pxEyfXcIPAflJ8wo33CYU5a7Vd6K55tCcSwLODDlL2Z7ADopuv676keoxNtCYqbdjeTMy3AsHXQRC_oZPQ6w4L7mqUGBUaOlGL0_am9Q1yo-FQqlbrBnl_BNL9TTVue0KcdTZZYZ53dDldvbm2aNoeIx73bhx1holT72SrDoap_Bu7nYv6WF-mSBTzOkPiqI95bTXRMb5-cFjpi1Ph5F5GiO-ylgdMN19xizI3l2QcTSkKJMKAO57iiRKzzrhthom0Yl60%3D)
---
But you and I know what McCarthy really means. **If I wasn 't around, it would "tremendously" benefit HIM.** There would be no one in Congress to expose his failure to fulfill the promises he made to the American people or anyone to bust up Uniparty's fascination with getting back to "business as usual," where lobbyists and PACs call the shots. That's why McCarthy wants me out. He didn't like that someone was finally holding him accountable. But if we are going to Drain the Swamp, this is exactly what needs to be done. Because we need leadership, who is beholden to the voters alone. **Not dark money special interest groups that are willing to destroy America from within to advance their own agenda.**
| [ **STAND WITH GAETZ - DRAIN THE SWAMP** ](http://links.fighttheswamp.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=165cd436408044259605c7e8b0ff18a6&_e=WbKNOZMwGpbZPRSxbupneST4oryxEMNrq_sHTrybx_r_tHJVRJ7q3tIV2OACD2bxCB-NaE_cTKrz7aGCp3x_yb7TGdETHo_BRdcP2pxEyfXcIPAflJ8wo33CYU5a7Vd6K55tCcSwLODDlL2Z7ADopuv676keoxNtCYqbdjeTMy3AsHXQRC_oZPQ6w4L7mqUGCH0HGpdqyA_2o3cAIWB9IXQXzh2dHB_9_4COl4DZtp0pgWun8ohpF2Yg7AH2u8-pTfBOG_hj81SJ1PFUXDvt2na6S0F-0JnnMrrwZLdk4vESpwP8c4l1P4zkZImXf3NYRgmQqUN0nCuVYfn8n0mXb1FxWPcNIvJ8CzcHM3dSO18%3D)
---
Friend, it GETS WORSE. Yesterday, I had to file an ethics complaint against the Former Speaker after witnesses saw him attack Rep. Tim Burchett, who described it as a "sucker punch" and a "clean shot to the kidney." First off - thoughts and prayers, Mr. Former Speaker, as he works through all the stages of grief. But at the end of the day, I have more pressing matters than worrying about a disgruntled Former Speaker throwing temper tantrums,**like ensuring the American People are put first ahead of the upcoming government funding deadline.** The good news is we now have a new Speaker who embodies the America First movement, giving Washington the fresh start it desperately needed. Something McCarthy, the lobbyist, and Uniparty are obviously not happy about, which is how it SHOULD be. It's time we remind those in Washington who they are supposed to be working for, the people. But I can't do this on my own. Unlike so many in the Swamp, I am the only member of Congress who refuses all donations from federal lobbyists and PACs. That's because I work for you and you alone. NOT THEM. **And it 's why I am counting on the support of folks like you to join me once again to rid Washington of the corruption that has gone on for far too long.** **[Please stand with me by chipping in $10, $20, $30, or more so I can do what I do best and fight to Drain the Swamp completely.](http://links.fighttheswamp.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=165cd436408044259605c7e8b0ff18a6&_e=WbKNOZMwGpbZPRSxbupneST4oryxEMNrq_sHTrybx_r_tHJVRJ7q3tIV2OACD2bxCB-NaE_cTKrz7aGCp3x_yb7TGdETHo_BRdcP2pxEyfXcIPAflJ8wo33CYU5a7Vd6K55tCcSwLODDlL2Z7ADopuv676keoxNtCYqbdjeTMy3AsHXQRC_oZPQ6w4L7mqUGjkTLcBThwFoXtx7W5pxzRO0iuyK0jYwCquMzrp3lGYLTWiNXr_Pu7HAUbWbYrCalIPWQm4JXQdZv2iU93s0VZYmH05-1h4oWy3GdovQACJmIQdrt47aKLYWF9MDs67DU-f5xv5iFQX85ov8E-HvIjfCHd98qW4YtLIEJH1ZCtyE%3D)** With your help, along with the millions of other patriots, we can show the Deep State that there is no longer a place in Washington for those who chose to ignore the will of the American People. **[Join the fight to Drain the Swamp. >>>](http://links.fighttheswamp.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=165cd436408044259605c7e8b0ff18a6&_e=WbKNOZMwGpbZPRSxbupneST4oryxEMNrq_sHTrybx_r_tHJVRJ7q3tIV2OACD2bxCB-NaE_cTKrz7aGCp3x_yb7TGdETHo_BRdcP2pxEyfXcIPAflJ8wo33CYU5a7Vd6K55tCcSwLODDlL2Z7ADopuv676keoxNtCYqbdjeTMy3AsHXQRC_oZPQ6w4L7mqUGhQLLdT5il8tN3x2Yzigjo3l7KIdb6LQZ-YmgXPKQ1_VVgwWNAfjzogkzv_8FL6VN8-JenlhhCghUvjhgq09axsLiFDy3s-T043a5X7sftrIr6ypnbSMBFWLlgowIyXmAVWgTLTGRyRoJ4QZuhVMNcwSvEJGHUZzo6dKWlTM_-LM%3D)** _Thanks for standing strong,_ Matt Gaetz
| [ ](http://links.fighttheswamp.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=165cd436408044259605c7e8b0ff18a6&_e=WbKNOZMwGpbZPRSxbupneST4oryxEMNrq_sHTrybx_r_tHJVRJ7q3tIV2OACD2bxCB-NaE_cTKrz7aGCp3x_yb7TGdETHo_BRdcP2pxEyfXcIPAflJ8wo33CYU5a7Vd6K55tCcSwLODDlL2Z7ADopuv676keoxNtCYqbdjeTMy3AsHXQRC_oZPQ6w4L7mqUGV0dkLuHRSZUnCzjfQVRjSUQSK29L1h-l4DiReymI--FIDY8FZ-vQs65fgNbgpl4C4qKOken3Scr1DebR4agftErr4dZy6vil-EKKLdhDGEa3bhGzWzTBKenbptCj_HMPyad4VY3pwx-c_y0K13Ys8Y210IR5QHPfbpN4MiTBGrE%3D)

name: Elizabeth Warren
subject: This is insulting to the American people’s intelligence
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Warren for Senate
body:
We didn’t end up with an ethics-averting Supreme Court by chance

| | | [ ](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/216?t=3&akid=1821%2E4032634%2EzBEVVs)
---
The Supreme Court just announced a code of conduct for its justices. This comes after years of demands that members of the nation’s highest court be held to the highest standard of ethics. Here’s one problem, though: this code of conduct doesn’t include any way to enforce it. In other words, it’s useless. This announcement is an acknowledgment that public trust in the Court has plummeted. But this won’t solve the problem. It’s insulting to the American people’s intelligence that the Supreme Court proposed an ethics code without enforcement. In fact, “rules” that lack teeth actually risk legitimizing corrupt conduct. This is all part of a larger issue, though. We didn’t end up with an ethics-averting Supreme Court by chance. Out-of-touch ideologues have been spending decades stacking all levels of the federal judiciary with allies. Billionaires have been treating Supreme Court justices to secret gifts and lavish trips. And the Republican Party as a whole has been focusing on capturing the courts to enact unpopular agenda items that wouldn’t stand a chance at the ballot box. That’s how they’ve ripped away the Constitutional right to an abortion, blocked student debt cancelation, shredded workers’ rights and voting rights, and made it easier to discriminate against LGBTQ+ people. **They didn’t get it done overnight, and we can’t unwind it overnight either. They had a plan. They put it into place. But I’ve got a plan, too — a plan for us to fight back and correct course:** **In the shorter-term:** President Biden has nominated (and our Democratic Senate has been confirming) a historically diverse slate of judicial nominees — including civil rights attorneys, legal aid lawyers, and public defenders. Getting more professional diversity on our courts is powerfully important, and something I’ve called for for a long time. I’ve also been pushing for an actually binding code of ethics for Supreme Court justices, with accountability mechanisms, because it’s clear that Congress must act if the Supreme Court won’t. And I’ve reintroduced my Judicial Ethics and Anti-Corruption Act, which would block off the special lanes of influence that powerful interests and billionaires have paved for themselves, ban federal judges from owning or trading individual stocks, and make Supreme Court Justices finally follow a basic and enforceable code of ethics. **For the longer-term:** To rebalance a Supreme Court that’s been hijacked by extremists, we must expand it. I didn’t come to this conclusion lightly. But far-right justices keep substituting politics for the rule of law, and we must add more seats to rebalance this institution and restore its integrity. Additionally, we must fix the Electoral College so popular-vote losers like Donald Trump can’t stack the courts again. Remember: Five justices who ended the right to abortion were appointed by presidents who lost the popular vote. [**Add your name if you agree with this plan: To undo the damage done by the right-wing takeover of our federal courts, we must continue to confirm more judges who respect the rule of law, root corruption out of the judiciary, and rebalance the Supreme Court by expanding it.**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/signup/wfs-scotus-reform/?source=EMZ17P_JUD_E_20231116_V1S1&t=8&akid=1821%2E4032634%2EzBEVVs) | [**ADD YOUR NAME**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/signup/wfs-scotus-reform/?source=EMZ17P_JUD_E_20231116_V1S1&t=9&akid=1821%2E4032634%2EzBEVVs)
---
Thanks for being a part of this,
Elizabeth
P.S. At the same time as we’re working to reform the judiciary, we can also keep fighting to undo the damage that extremists have done through our courts. President Biden is moving forward on other routes to cancel student debt. And, we can continue fighting back at the local level, by supporting statewide ballot initiative campaigns to protect abortion rights. I’m staying in this fight.

# **Portland Teacher Unions are not on the side of kids**
---
Friends,I am excited for Thanksgiving next week! It is my favorite time of the year as it starts us on the way towards Christmas. All the lighted parades and of course Civil War between Oregon and Oregon State, it should be a great week. Before we get to celebrations, I want to highlight how horrible the teachers unions have been treating kids in Portland and why this is bad for all of Oregon. The Legislature approved well over $10 Billion dollars for education in 2023. That is right over $10 Billion. Portland Public Schools (PPS) and Teachers Unions (OEA) were all aware and involved in the process. We ended session at the end of June. Did they start negotiating their contract then with teachers and PPS? NOPE. They waited until school started, kids and parents settling into routine of school and work. Then, drop the hammer! Let's strike and demand hundreds of millions of dollars! OEA is using the kids as political pawns to demand more. They want to get on the news, negotiate in the news and force PPS to give them more. Not in good faith, rather, you have no choice. Mind you, I have nothing but disdain for PPS and how they run their school district. It is probably the worst run school district in Oregon, but regardless it does not give OEA the right to hold kids education hostage for their demands. **My two friends, State Representatives Christine Goodwin and Jami Cate, are teaming up to help stop this from happening in the future.** 37 states have laws stopping unions from striking because they know how detrimental it is to KIDS. We are working on drafting legislation to this end. Not take away their right to negotiate a good contract, just don't do it at the expense of kids. We are working on bill to present in the education or labor committees stoping teachers unions from striking during school. Democrats we bet won't even hear the bill because they are lock step in the back pocket of OEA and union bosses. It won't stop us from trying and pushing hard. Let Representative Cate and Goodwin know they are on the right track if you have a minute. You can find their information below. I am sure some people disagree with our take, that is ok too. Hard conversations must be had if we ever want to have good legislation. I am not afraid of that. Portland Democrats have no problem telling us how to live our lives all over Oregon. _We have no problem standing up to them_ and their far left progressive ideas destroying our largest city in Oregon too.God Bless,Vikki

Campaigns are won on the ground, talking directly one-on-one to voters, so I need eager, energetic, and experienced organizers in the field coordinating our volunteers.

Friend,
My team is expanding. I have hired an experienced field director, Hunter Evans to help me succeed in organizing volunteers and canvassing our massive rural district.
Hunter started his political career at just 16, and now, after nearly a decade in the field, his experience in political organizing makes him a great fit.
He is passionate about healthcare and political organizing, and most recently worked at a non-profit that helped rural youth obtain insurance.
Hunter understands the importance of Medicare for All, and it motivated him to get involved as a volunteer collecting petition signatures for me.

I am running for Congress to fight for livable wages and family sustaining jobs , because everyone in our community deserves the opportunity to thrive.

That is why I am asking for your help today.
Because our grassroots campaign is funded entirely through donations of individuals like you, your generosity helps me provide Hunter with the resources he needs to do his job well.
Friend, please consider chipping in whatever so we can continue paying great staffers like Hunter. $5, $50, or $500, every dollar makes a huge difference.

Bob

Peter -

I’m still settling into my new office – both the physical space and the position I now hold in the federal government. I’m going to be honest with you, the last few weeks have been a blur – but productive and exciting as well.

Believe it or not, there wasn’t a manual left behind that I can reference in this new role. So, as you can imagine, we’ve been wasting no time settling in and figuring out how to best prioritize your interests and needs. The American people deserve nothing less than my best and that’s what I intend to give.

[**I’m reaching out today because I want to make sure that my team has the appropriate email, phone number, and mailing address on file for you.**](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=7e406f595d6347259cb92cd68a656b98&_e=LH8l3gRYElqB6CZc4MKYdQ6WGlrCA4Dg8cVXCogI0HQc4N3X7sPpRXFBieAklhzW3mCMZ25D9jlAIgahfT9tZjjb_xsuu3EYMZ47Xh2D10gcKTptn1XnP85V42dLdGdTfvRrxjqRB23IbxmuPskG1G8TaJJXf9jbQIpGzQd9_AGStBVuJ6Pe5T0IzbwhUnj7bjrBB9orqlbhqJNy_k_1VRaCzF2LrV1BBBZs631w5fuplfnR3lN3-p6WAhBrVX6wB-2u0gbl1reey6RVUaAZECDMoBxVYJGdNQct347BKpsCUXwYBmy6D6ljZfKgnK2Uv8tnCk_RKnQKQIYeXpB-XtKh15LpNvLA9oeGoCnivuZaFPfOJS2Dw5H1wMWAm9-8uS1iyO90ZJ7ztGG4xRA74RabO2C7J2ye6h8dfUO1YYc%3D)

Holding on to the House majority in next November’s election is going to be a tall order – [**but with you on our team, I know our chances will increase exponentially.**](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=7e406f595d6347259cb92cd68a656b98&_e=LH8l3gRYElqB6CZc4MKYdQ6WGlrCA4Dg8cVXCogI0HQc4N3X7sPpRXFBieAklhzW3mCMZ25D9jlAIgahfT9tZjjb_xsuu3EYMZ47Xh2D10gcKTptn1XnP85V42dLdGdTfvRrxjqRB23IbxmuPskG1G8TaJJXf9jbQIpGzQd9_AGStBVuJ6Pe5T0IzbwhUnj7bjrBB9orqlbhqJNy_k_1VRaCzF2LrV1BBBZs631w5fuplfnR3lN3-p6WAhBrVX6wB-2u0gbl1reey6RVUaAZEAX2DPvLQUpbbq0gHjFQFC3hSigBp3SKf1FV7n-5wltdwBDjWUNdBSO1meWjhu5PUCPlUZM4uwfFGlh0AqAurk3yRzeNFNk7FWN6U_INEcRs8OyPelr9hG7vXlHkEwr8uyomEiS5lRqm8P6zZenwMtI%3D)

We’re emailing today to make sure we have the information we need to contact you. | | Peter - I’m still settling into my new office – both the physical space and the position I now hold in the federal government. I’m going to be honest with you, the last few weeks have been a blur – but productive and exciting as well. Believe it or not, there wasn’t a manual left behind that I can reference in this new role. So, as you can imagine, we’ve been wasting no time settling in and figuring out how to best prioritize your interests and needs. The American people deserve nothing less than my best and that’s what I intend to give. Before my colleagues elected me the 56th Speaker of the House, our mailing list was mainly comprised of folks from the great state of Louisiana. But now as Speaker, every Republican in the country is a constituent of mine and I need to be able to know I can reach out as needed. Holding on to the House majority in next November’s election is going to be a tall order – I’ll be honest with you, before I was elected to lead the House a few weeks ago, I was relatively unknown nationally, meaning I probably didn’t have you on my mailing list. As we build out our campaign operation from the ground up, I am going to need every patriot to step forward. So please, With respect, Mike Johnson Speaker of the House As Speaker, I want to hear from you on the top issues of the day. It's important for us to deliver results for the American people. name: Joe Kent
subject: need your feedback on my new radio ad
disclaimer_text: Paid for by the Joe Kent Victory Fund
body:
Dear Peter,
I couldn't believe my ears when I heard it: my opponent Congresswoman Marie Perez - the most vulnerable Democrat in the country - is so desperate to hang onto her seat that she's using taxpayer dollars to fund her campaign ads that are running right now in my district.
It's one of Congress's most corrupt practices - letting incumbents use their office budgets to pay for campaign mailers, phone calls, and even TV and radio ads. It's so corrupt that the US Senate banned it - but it's still "legal" for members of the US House.
And it's corruption my opponent is shamelessly engaging in.
Even worse, her ads are bragging about her support for veterans, even though she voted with every other Democrat to defund veterans' healthcare.
I wasn't going to just sit back and let this misinformation spread - so I responded with a radio ad of my own running back-to-back with hers. You can hear it here: [https://JoeKentforCongress.com/Veterans](https://contact.joekentforcongress.com/l/yKnBAvy7a4tJj7XnOa763cIw/Vhhmp3kqnl892GR4ChcAx0zQ/hdafd7wQIy9U0tBjJtEVnA).
But unlike Marie Perez, I'm paying for my ad with campaign donations. Will you please help us keep this ad on the air with a contribution? You can donate at [https://JoeKentforCongress.com](https://contact.joekentforcongress.com/l/yKnBAvy7a4tJj7XnOa763cIw/cgeBNCGQyruV9M444FRtFQ/hdafd7wQIy9U0tBjJtEVnA).
The irony is that Marie Perez also voted to keep our troops in warzones like Syria where we have no direct national interests - while at the same time voting to eliminate funding for their healthcare when they return injured.
I have a real plan to help our veterans - I know because I have first-hand experience with the VA as a veteran myself.
Both the radio ad and my plan are online at [https://JoeKentforCongress.com/Veterans](https://contact.joekentforcongress.com/l/yKnBAvy7a4tJj7XnOa763cIw/Vhhmp3kqnl892GR4ChcAx0zQ/hdafd7wQIy9U0tBjJtEVnA), and I'd be grateful if you take a look and share your thoughts with me.
Thank you and God Bless,
Joe Kent
PS - My opponent Marie Perez is paying for her campaign ads with taxpayer dollars to lie about her disastrous record on veterans issues. Help me keep our donor-funded radio ad on the air to counter her by contributing at [https://JoeKentforCongress.com/donate](https://contact.joekentforcongress.com/l/yKnBAvy7a4tJj7XnOa763cIw/IeZMZIsd5KDTWYvGbloMYQ/hdafd7wQIy9U0tBjJtEVnA).

| **Madera County Supervisor Robert Poythress
Endorses John Duarte for Congress **** **
---
| | **Modesto, CA – **Today, Congressman John Duarte (R-CA13) is proud to announce an endorsement from Madera County Supervisor Robert Poythress. Supervisor Poythress is a local leader in Madera County, having served as a City Councilman and Madera’s first elected Mayor. Robert Poythress was first elected to the Madera Board of Supervisors in 2016 and was re-elected in 2020.

“John is committed to Central Valley farmers, businesses, and hard-working families," said Supervisor Poythress. "He works across the aisle in Washington, tackling agriculture, water, and energy issues, determined to find solutions that best help Valley families. I endorse his campaign for Congress and look forward to continuing to work alongside him.”

Duarte responded to the endorsement, saying, “I am grateful to have the support from Madera County Supervisor Poythress. Our local leaders, like Supervisor Poythress, make the biggest difference for our community neighborhoods and residents. I am proud to partner with Poythress to tackle Madera County’s toughest issues, and I look forward to continuing to work with him in the future.”

Please visit [www.johnduarteforcongress.com](https://johnduarteforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d614871a572868b235b65477d&id=b0518a5330&e=76a47b375f) for more information about the campaign. ###

Last week, we celebrated a major victory after the Democrats’ case to strike my name from the ballot in a key battleground state was DISMISSED by the state’s Supreme Court.
_**And now, we can celebrate ANOTHER VICTORY after a judge dismissed the Democrats’ case to remove my name from the ballot in Michigan.**_
**“Michigan judge allows Donald Trump to stay on presidential primary ballot”**
[SOURCE: _Detroit News_]
This wasn’t just a victory for our campaign. It was a victory for our Republic and the sanctity of _YOUR_ vote.
Let this victory serve as yet another reminder...
...When _WE_ stand tall and **NEVER SURRENDER** our country to tyranny, we WIN!
Over the course of the year, we’ve witnessed the most vicious witch hunts imaginable. I’ve been wrongfully arrested four times, forced to take a mugshot, my home has been raided, I’ve been denied a trial by jury, and I’m facing over 1,000 years in prison as an innocent man.
And yet, here we are – racking up victories in court and dominating in the polls.
This is why we can never, ever quit!
Even when it seems like we’re facing impossible odds, we can never give up! Because we wouldn’t just be giving up on a campaign. We’d be giving up on _America_.
**And at this very moment, Crooked Joe and the Democrats are _still_ scheming ways to try and CANCEL OUT YOUR VOTE and remove us from the 2024 ballot in other critical battleground states.**

And yet, here we are – racking up victories in court and dominating in the polls. This is why we can never, ever quit! Even when it seems like we’re facing impossible odds, we can never give up! Because we wouldn’t just be giving up on a campaign. We’d be giving up on America. And at this very moment, Crooked Joe and the Democrats are still scheming ways to try and CANCEL OUT YOUR VOTE and remove us from the 2024 ballot in other critical battleground states. | | | Friend,
Back in early October, 8 Republicans (including me) voted to TAKE DOWN the Establishment and REMOVE Establishment Speaker Kevin McCarthy from leadership.
But even though we scored a major victory, **the Establishment is DOWN, not OUT.**
And **they’ve turned their fire on me for daring to stand up to them.** They want to make me an example, so no other Republican ever challenges their vice-grip on power.
I say bring it on, but I can’t do it alone. **[I need more resources to fight back against the Establishment’s Dark Money onslaught.](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zef1v4c5av04bua3bincvljk07cn65gibi5mfndo_rp22sh2s8i6eo30c9i6aoj4cph2bs)**

* And I made sure to ALWAYS **vote my conscience as a conservative...**

...which is why I have a **100% rating** from Club for Growth, 100% from National Right to Life, 99% from NumbersUSA on immigration, and 89% from Heritage Action.
As a husband, a father, a grandfather and a patriot, **I know that conservatives are running out of chances to set our country back on the right path.**
And I know that this fight won’t be won by the Establishment... but by **regular Americans stepping up to fight in the trenches** for the nation we know and love.
And, as the 8 of us fighting in Congress proved: **when conservatives unite together AGAINST the Establishment,_we can’t be stopped._**

name: 1600 Daily
subject: The greatest armed conflict in human history
body:
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us.

This sponsored message from 1600 Daily News is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z3b1o25dat5qqghqtguohfuhe6h484hoa2h0q7t8_rp22sh2s8i6eo30c9h64ob2cth2bs) Dear Fellow American,
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us. This fact means that we’re losing more and more living memory of the greatest armed conflict in human history, which makes the study of World War II even more important.
To this end, Hillsdale College has produced an online course entitled “The Second World Wars.”
Taught by historian Victor Davis Hanson, this course explores how the conflict’s diverse theaters, belligerents, and ways of fighting came eventually to define a single war. And it examines the key investments, strategies, and leaders that led the Allied powers to victory over the Axis. [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z2a6f53pu3fj78h3e23it5e6k8h5m83oshap83ho_rp22sh2s8i6eo30c9h64ob2cth2bs) If you’d like to secure a DVD set before they’re all gone, you can get one shipped directly to your home for any gift of $100 or more to Hillsdale College.

name: Your America
subject: The greatest armed conflict in human history
body:
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us.

This sponsored message from Your America News is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c36535%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=%2bs5MfLJTksB2xbW9L3ykIg&sysid=1) Dear Fellow American,
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us. This fact means that we’re losing more and more living memory of the greatest armed conflict in human history, which makes the study of World War II even more important.
To this end, Hillsdale College has produced an online course entitled “The Second World Wars.”
Taught by historian Victor Davis Hanson, this course explores how the conflict’s diverse theaters, belligerents, and ways of fighting came eventually to define a single war. And it examines the key investments, strategies, and leaders that led the Allied powers to victory over the Axis. [](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c36536%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=qp4lJWXRu165iQ8sJvrq9g&sysid=1) If you’d like to secure a DVD set before they’re all gone, you can get one shipped directly to your home for any gift of $100 or more to Hillsdale College.
Here’s a secure link to reserve your copy of “**The Second World Wars** ” on DVD:
**[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/support-the-second-world-wars](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c36537%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=kcJ6wBz6hLS897L9Q76bCg&sysid=1)**
Thank you for preserving liberty for future generations of Americans through education with Hillsdale College!
Best regards,
Kyle Murnen, ’09 Director of Online Learning Hillsdale College

subject: Survey on an urgent matter
body:
It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation's future.

| | This sponsored message from Conservatives Gives is on behalf of Hillsdale College | [](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=365f4313d6e041ef92dd32505f8413f8&_e=TY8hWmmGQN7HgoUptVRzYAG1_6dj_jKKQ5yGm_n_e5zYf_TaJWL4ef_Lzg2b-wSwCt-3rq2IlqzLTpDEDVVNTIeCpFhQwmmvOHh0rKyo_kB5C75rqTqZL5O7jZENt1X-J7bPz_C3V7662NTTfqdeZtFVowX9ETRr7AY1I7XRhUPC9YKzW1FBKjB1oIGgBHPfNF4fFT5D-0y8npl8V9St7E2ahemRFrBYLykP0qaw35dA-n6LA7x1ijUaPPRp-4QW4EqWG8L68Dz-K4Eq_SP6zzzGrYHjcYYIfNl1ePgc5dFlytPVbt4jMSFbf7OxakkFwB_20DHbDrOdGjmAe0RJPcgSBeAPTG5ThL_rCxUeZ1fJ-62YO1fkc3mgF0Mzf2Izut5F_F4Ew3BwSH96SljxL-CrYjN2rxn9LdlqJ5KtXPY%3D)
---
| |
Dear Fellow American, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation's future. A movement is growing, led by progressives--but supported by many well-meaning Americans--to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That's why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue--views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection **by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=365f4313d6e041ef92dd32505f8413f8&_e=TY8hWmmGQN7HgoUptVRzYAG1_6dj_jKKQ5yGm_n_e5zYf_TaJWL4ef_Lzg2b-wSwCt-3rq2IlqzLTpDEDVVNTIeCpFhQwmmvOHh0rKyo_kB5C75rqTqZL5O7jZENt1X-J7bPz_C3V7662NTTfqdeZtFVowX9ETRr7AY1I7XRhUPC9YKzW1FBKjB1oIGgBHPfNF4fFT5D-0y8npl8V9St7E2ahemRFrBYLykP0qaw35dA-n6LA7x1ijUaPPRp-4QWyT1hGBikelOQRn-biVYtstA-zy7C7OdeCu-J3ZmosXsBDx3PeR2vTNLwzFzkzdrB5STfujNkJxqGIWdHFfbw0yxFZAagpjFtY-rCDSssobu7_XrEnsAGU0MMcpF7sdBYvmXqdBhk49EF8OFfG-F3rZWrJD7vZi_oZXPyrTGZTHE%3D)**
## Do you think that most Americans understand how the Electoral College works and its role in preserving free and representative government?
[YES](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=365f4313d6e041ef92dd32505f8413f8&_e=TY8hWmmGQN7HgoUptVRzYAG1_6dj_jKKQ5yGm_n_e5zYf_TaJWL4ef_Lzg2b-wSwCt-3rq2IlqzLTpDEDVVNTIeCpFhQwmmvOHh0rKyo_kB5C75rqTqZL5O7jZENt1X-J7bPz_C3V7662NTTfqdeZtFVowX9ETRr7AY1I7XRhUPC9YKzW1FBKjB1oIGgBHPfNF4fFT5D-0y8npl8V9St7E2ahemRFrBYLykP0qaw35dA-n6LA7x1ijUaPPRp-4QWIStPktZyY-m2tuG4focx0y0L0Ai3-WDrbdwPJwbgQewFzJrQ7s9kBrJ9MDsEikP5gq3eAF04fm90er4CLksSwtXT07C4YmQvCMoirr29tGRxEh9PR-tpU6nW5UkOBzws1WWK3z9laXlQLttLHniw-l6CCPwqMS_nUacMt9Dt5Ts%3D) [NO](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=365f4313d6e041ef92dd32505f8413f8&_e=TY8hWmmGQN7HgoUptVRzYAG1_6dj_jKKQ5yGm_n_e5zYf_TaJWL4ef_Lzg2b-wSwCt-3rq2IlqzLTpDEDVVNTIeCpFhQwmmvOHh0rKyo_kB5C75rqTqZL5O7jZENt1X-J7bPz_C3V7662NTTfqdeZtFVowX9ETRr7AY1I7XRhUPC9YKzW1FBKjB1oIGgBHPfNF4fFT5D-0y8npl8V9St7E2ahemRFrBYLykP0qaw35dA-n6LA7x1ijUaPPRp-4QWcDZhmVzEZB1xd4ravvTW_o0NTxukvcTOKciENmd3UFixPab1aECLt64IN1trrQH9YCX-K7ahv2WkEMU8TLyZoUgAi3XgB5BY0DCaMGf-zhld4duZn9x8b3H3OsbboGjx9ArhtS8nmgr8qnvHkYqBtAf7iV_5wrGutr_3ehXYBng%3D) For most of our nation's history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government. **But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.** This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America's schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics--too many Americans simply don't understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty. Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching **millions** of Americans in all 50 states. These efforts, which aim to counter the Left's domination over most of our schools, include:
* **Teaching** millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as "Constitution 101" and "The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;"
* **Reaching** over six million households and businesses nationwide with _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale's free digest of liberty;
* **Promoting** constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;
* **Sending** millions of pocket-size copies of America's founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America; and
* **Restoring** excellence to K-12 education by helping establish and guiding classical K-12 schools nationwide and providing, free of charge, Hillsdale's American classical K-12 curriculum (including American civics) to thousands of American educators and homeschoolers.

Your answers to the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty--including the importance of the Electoral College. **And this is especially important in this critical time for America 's future.** So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our **National Survey on Presidential Selection** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. **You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below:

**[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=365f4313d6e041ef92dd32505f8413f8&_e=TY8hWmmGQN7HgoUptVRzYAG1_6dj_jKKQ5yGm_n_e5zYf_TaJWL4ef_Lzg2b-wSwCt-3rq2IlqzLTpDEDVVNTIeCpFhQwmmvOHh0rKyo_kB5C75rqTqZL5O7jZENt1X-J7bPz_C3V7662NTTfqdeZtFVowX9ETRr7AY1I7XRhUPC9YKzW1FBKjB1oIGgBHPfNF4fFT5D-0y8npl8V9St7E2ahemRFrBYLykP0qaw35dA-n6LA7x1ijUaPPRp-4QWFj3dtTV_H14I1xeV-_eBtVkyV7sObH6QxSTvzBzGR1yOMOfZyGB725JSp9qR5LVzf36Uik0_uxPDsE0g0paaF6BrXQGLzHHwEclEEICZc9c1z11wxUIYFS3LDfU_UQ-XCGyQZdQ8NvTmgfuocEvFkjEAfClH0EPfuRWY_YhC-_Q%3D)**
** And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift. Since 1844, Hillsdale has been "pursuing truth and defending liberty." Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work. Please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Presidential Selection today**. Thank you for your time and attention--and for your friendship and support of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

| It’s no secret that Vanguard, Fidelity and Charles Schwab could be considered three of the most popular and well-known brokerage firms. Each offers a wide range of products and services, from banking and investment products to financial advisors and financial planning services.

However, there are some important differences, from fees to financial services to research resources, each of which could impact your customer experience. [Learn how these firms stack up so you can decide on the fit for you.](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c674612%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=aGwXxe3DYG2zZMXXlCRZqw&sysid=1)
### Overview of Vanguard vs. Fidelity vs. Schwab
Vanguard made a name for itself by creating and offering low-fee investment products such as mutual funds and exchange-traded funds (ETFs). It still does this, and even non-Vanguard clients can buy Vanguard funds via a brokerage account. The firm has grown to now offer non-proprietary investment products and funds.

Fidelity is perhaps best known for its personal investment products, namely brokerage accounts that allow users to trade stocks. Clients can invest in a wide range of stocks, bonds and other investment products using a Fidelity brokerage account. Schwab has a number of passively and actively managed funds that you can invest your money into. You also have the option to trade individual equities. The snowy forest floor is **painted red.** A mama wolf lies lifeless and limp. Her body has been shredded by the bullets of a trophy hunter. Her babies wait patiently in the den for a dinner that will never come. **Without mom, they could starve or freeze to death. Even worse, they may end up staring down the barrel of a gun themselves.** **[Wolf pups shouldn’t have to fight for their lives when they’ve barely begun. Donate $27 to Friends of the Earth today to help us reach our $4,400 goal and stand up for vulnerable wildlife and our planet!](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2126723?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)**
Hunting season is already in full swing. And the coming winter could be dangerous for our nation’s surviving wolf packs. Only **6,000 wolves remain in the lower 48 states.** They can’t afford another brutal hunting season.
But the odds are stacked against wolves. Hunters are pushing to dismantle protections for wolves so they can keep killing for “fun”. And to make matters worse, they have some help. Big Polluters are in the fight against protections for wolves, too. With wolves out of the way, they’d be able to take over the land for mining and logging. _**Together, these greedy interests could drive wolves to extinction.**_
But I have good news. It’s not too late to strengthen vital protections for wolves and other vulnerable wildlife. Thanks to members like you, we still have the chance to make real change happen. But we need your help to act now before the loss is too great! Will you join us in this fight?
[](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2126724?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
**Baby wolf pups are fighting to survive. Rush your $27 donation today and help us reach our $4,400 goal to protect wildlife and the planet!**
_If you've saved payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:_
| | **[Donate $27 immediately ](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2126719?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)**
---

---
| | **[Donate $100 immediately](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2126721?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)**
---
| | **[Donate another amount](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2126722?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)**
---
Every wolf death is devastating. But the scariest part is the way hunters are killing wolves. They’re using some of the most brutal hunting methods we’ve seen.
Because for trophy hunters, it isn’t enough to simply kill a wolf. Hunters killing for sport needlessly terrorize these helpless animals. They resort to **painful neck snares,** leaving wolves to choke to death in futile attempts to escape. They **chase them down with helicopters.** In some states, it’s even legal to **DYNAMITE nursing wolf mamas and their baby pups inside their dens!**
No animal deserves this fate, Friend. But if we don’t act soon, it could get even easier for hunters to viciously torture and kill wolves in droves. That’s because Big Polluters are using their massive influence to help trophy hunters strip away the last few protections wolves still have. **If they get their way, they could wipe out wolves.** All so they can take over their lands and open them up for destructive mining and logging. _**That would also destroy any possibility of wolves being able to recover in the future.**_
Trophy hunters and Big Polluters have shown time and again that they care more about lining their pockets than the lives of wolves and survival of our planet. But Friend, is private profit really worth all of this bloodshed and destruction?
**Our wildlife should come before corporate profit. Rush your $27 donation now before wolves and vulnerable wildlife are driven to extinction and it’s too late for our planet.**
_If you've saved payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:_
| | **[Donate $27 immediately ](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2126719?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)**
---
| | **[Donate $50 immediately](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2126720?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)**
---
| | **[Donate $100 immediately](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2126721?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)**
---
| | **[Donate another amount](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2126722?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)**
---
Here’s what we’re up against: Powerful trophy hunting and Big Oil lobbies are fighting tooth and nail against protections for wolves. _**Now, the U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service is ignoring science-backed wolf recovery practices.**_ That means struggling wolf populations are being abandoned in pro-hunting states like Montana.
And losing wolves would have serious impacts on our planet. Wolves are a keystone species. They help balance out their ecosystems by keeping prey populations in check. Not to mention, scavengers rely on their kills to sustain them. Without wolves, other plant and animal species could suffer.
**With hunting season in full swing, it’s never been more important to stand up for wolves.** Friends of the Earth is fighting with everything we have to strengthen the Endangered Species Act. A vital piece of legislation, the ESA allows us to shield endangered species from violence. Even more, it gives us the power to block destructive industries like Big Oil, logging, and factory farming from destroying critical habitats for profit and polluting the communities that rely on them. That’s why we’ve collected thousands of comments from supporters just like you -- urging our elected leaders to put an end to these vicious attacks against the ESA.
Your membership gift will go a long way to further support our planet-saving work. But we’re up against some powerful foes. Private trophy-hunting interests and Big Polluters have seemingly bottomless resources to get their way. That’s why I’m asking for your help today. We are falling $2,011 short of our goal. But if just 8 more activists from your area make a $27 membership contribution today, we can reach our $4,400 goal and make real change for wildlife and the planet. Will you stand with us today?
**Wolves, vulnerable species, and our planet are on the line. Donate $27 today and help us hit our $4,400 goal by midnight tonight!**

## Do you agree that there is a double standard for members of the administrative state--that the ruling elite is not required to follow the same rules as other Americans?
[YES](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=73e817e2aec440e0912b30f170be6ff6&_e=GCulBw51ljNqwKeVxTWBgxm18nbdl3RsW1R3eMIMWxZfupYh9LzHPN10Nb6rp0r3P0cfF4_rkL3kjldVOMmw9q3bW462Mo8xZUehdBYq_tcK2_k0j7Vk78BKaGtr0Z0EnyllILrqBA6o-q3dZOSpksiS4MmXYjOFUJxVDOvL2inMpUwK027EMG-ew0HW1G-s1ZibEHHtp8cByyqq2rlandlmgFv-vhm01dIfFhLodSfg_xScyrORirgxxQWekV2FheFwbScZh2LKvVE4nijLwIi04xvFTKNmYS3XnQydTRH0SUOgbb7SdaKmD3lIxLXZbCjMdPZysIdjcTBJ93Qm96EMSsFDApSwk1rK9RVPqMrRTtaC4ZaDTNKuHGnegP2BnqEJppBAnCpTxtlX-AgbC4gShdn46AE9223GTf1SjBM%3D) [NO](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=73e817e2aec440e0912b30f170be6ff6&_e=GCulBw51ljNqwKeVxTWBgxm18nbdl3RsW1R3eMIMWxZfupYh9LzHPN10Nb6rp0r3P0cfF4_rkL3kjldVOMmw9q3bW462Mo8xZUehdBYq_tcK2_k0j7Vk78BKaGtr0Z0EnyllILrqBA6o-q3dZOSpksiS4MmXYjOFUJxVDOvL2inMpUwK027EMG-ew0HW1G-s1ZibEHHtp8cByyqq2rlandlmgFv-vhm01dIfFhLodSfg_xScyrORirgxxQWekV2FheFwbScZh2LKvVE4nijLwMqcpvGywqG1UCWLK0ZyY5yckVpKURcjOaQuBbNapcU9FCrs5HU-X7Xf3dxM53p1MHrqbY9xsurs4OJ4rmNHuciOR_n2mnvBti6Ue-l0F4pPD-xPyHYcRLIj8oIvrRi4TGqFDn2jQ_Bz6xkKDUkXyz4%3D) Responding will only take a few minutes. It's a crisis that involves a fundamental political question: **who rules whom?**

The Constitution established a limited government in which the **people** ruled through their elected officials. Under this form of government, America became the freest and most prosperous nation in history.

Today, however, our constitutional system is one that increasingly exists in name only. **The Constitution of "We the People" is being replaced by an elite, out-of-touch, and unaccountable administrative state that rules without the consent of American citizens.** This means we live in an era of growing bureaucratic despotism, manifested in an administrative state that bypasses the Constitution, rejects the separation of powers, and replaces the rule of law with regulations.

**But we can 't just TALK about the problem. We also have to TAKE ACTION--to DO SOMETHING about it, while there's still time to save our country. **

That is why I'm writing to you today.

Hillsdale College is committed to returning to the Constitution of "We the People"--before it's too late.

## Do you agree that there is a double standard for members of the administrative state--that the ruling elite is not required to follow the same rules as other Americans?
[YES](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=72d98b127fba465e8564bc62d4bffced&_e=MOJgjjzIPBZiE1AWW_xGppd7G0MnDTNsW3CKofyk64QCIS237RvGRfCp4OAeGhikcixmPulKR2m7lrqcKyLy8sZ48dZssXw9SvUmlY7STMZ1zClM1RdsNEiwY0Xtjv1YGCUSUZrvt0Gk7PryaKDvJ7Gc7cnFklfU02QuGZafYyr0RvwSafMmIvfx57nUNBn_fHzoVimlowKYaCqTiKwGh2eoZYq1S7Ez_fKxDyT9WJKUqMCCusRHPX-wumBXqGAhhnu8VRXQ4ZygOfRh-TwmkO8h8b7TNlhMOuXR-QcnMgcEX9IftLmLKLNZLkIPhshijru2mD-VeLgBlr0AA4eu0r_QIYTKzAeQUJ45Hxq8LguCFnlVd_Akq6gmFxVeNUTJgJCyfjcAE-lH-iJDw7rZjWBqFzJ8EYF4JEhu2NiXYLc%3D) [NO](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=72d98b127fba465e8564bc62d4bffced&_e=MOJgjjzIPBZiE1AWW_xGppd7G0MnDTNsW3CKofyk64QCIS237RvGRfCp4OAeGhikcixmPulKR2m7lrqcKyLy8sZ48dZssXw9SvUmlY7STMZ1zClM1RdsNEiwY0Xtjv1YGCUSUZrvt0Gk7PryaKDvJ7Gc7cnFklfU02QuGZafYyr0RvwSafMmIvfx57nUNBn_fHzoVimlowKYaCqTiKwGh2eoZYq1S7Ez_fKxDyT9WJKUqMCCusRHPX-wumBXqGAhhnu8VRXQ4ZygOfRh-TwmkG9mcaxnYgMMCpDBkwLEwT_uf5IZW9c4ok6d511AFziuY6uAwVl72hWDKT1-P1XOamIiAKtR97u9xoIojQN4OE83zmkLLvnDH7ACccYlH_UPnw_p1UTsTVhhKR9rbPy4EvgGQ1l8iABzkvinW7T1jbY%3D) Responding will only take a few minutes. Your input as an informed patriot is needed right away...because **our country is facing a constitutional crisis**.

It's a crisis that involves a fundamental political question: **who rules whom?**

The Constitution established a limited government in which the **people** ruled through their elected officials. Under this form of government, America became the freest and most prosperous nation in history.

Today, however, our constitutional system is one that increasingly exists in name only. **The Constitution of "We the People" is being replaced by an elite, out-of-touch, and unaccountable administrative state that rules without the consent of American citizens.** This means we live in an era of growing bureaucratic despotism, manifested in an administrative state that bypasses the Constitution, rejects the separation of powers, and replaces the rule of law with regulations.

**But we can 't just TALK about the problem. We also have to TAKE ACTION--to DO SOMETHING about it, while there's still time to save our country. **

That is why I'm writing to you today.

Hillsdale College is committed to returning to the Constitution of "We the People"--before it's too late.

To do that, I need your input. What are your opinions on this topic--knowing that we can propose SOLUTIONS that will restore liberty?

**Please let me know your thoughts today by answering the National Referendum on the Administrative State using this secure link:**

**[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/administrative-state-survey/](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=72d98b127fba465e8564bc62d4bffced&_e=MOJgjjzIPBZiE1AWW_xGppd7G0MnDTNsW3CKofyk64QCIS237RvGRfCp4OAeGhikcixmPulKR2m7lrqcKyLy8sZ48dZssXw9SvUmlY7STMZ1zClM1RdsNEiwY0Xtjv1YGCUSUZrvt0Gk7PryaKDvJ7Gc7cnFklfU02QuGZafYyr0RvwSafMmIvfx57nUNBn_fHzoVimlowKYaCqTiKwGh2eoZYq1S7Ez_fKxDyT9WJKUqMCCusRHPX-wumBXqGAhhnu8VRXQ4ZygOfRh-TwmkKFCkwZ0k0BAWPB19YsYPCuwTrdOUWjMoT9f-bFD4sCIVBOwJol2lb1kWQ1nQBf98Umj-2aywWcIkaSHRqI-F8Aman0-KX3xNNz3qxjFG-yO7Jw0_D1oNJSsoCyIAe75ETrtDS4kJMZTEepM57jc6Hs%3D)**

Thank you for being on the side of the Constitution and liberty!

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn

body:
Dear Pro-Life Friend,

Republicans are going to keep refusing to stand up for innocent preborn life – as long as they think they can get away with it.

Well, with your help, I’m about to send a **_LOUD-AND-CLEAR_** message in Nebraska that no Republican in the country is going to miss.

You see, this past spring, the Nebraska Unicameral Legislature was so close to passing a law that would’ve prevented the abortions of babies with detectable heartbeats saving nearly 70% of babies from abortions. . .

But Pro-Life Friend, one Republican – Senator Merv Riepe – single-handedly stopped the state’s _Heartbeat Bill_ from passing!

Now, he’s going to pay the price. . .

In fact, we’re renting out billboard space on the busiest highway running through the Cornhusker State to let Nebraskans know that **_THIS ONE GUY**_ is responsible for the deaths of thousands of innocent Nebraska babies!

But you see, I need to get this billboard up so people can see it ASAP – **[so could you please make your most generous contribution of $250, $100, $50, or $25 to _Students for Life Action_ right away to help me with that](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-sjulrit-duchtdja-y/)?**

Pro-Life Friend, take a quick look at the billboard that is going to be seen by tens of thousands of people driving through southwest Omaha!

[](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-sjulrit-duchtdja-j/)
And once we do so, Republicans nationwide are going to be reminded that we aren’t going to let **ANY** squishy Republicans get away with this kind of behavior!

If we don’t take stand now, I fear that Republicans will continue to wave the white flag on abortion. _And they’ll keep losing elections as a result._

Just take Virginia Governor Glenn Youngkin for example.

Governor Youngkin raised millions of dollars for his “Spirit of Virginia” PAC from big-wig GOP donors all over the country and spent it on a TV ad campaign stating **“ _Here’s the truth: There is no ban_ ”** on abortion.

_The moment that ad came out, our team saw the energy from pro-lifers around “Old Dominion” tank as many just felt punched in the gut_.

The 15-week “limit” Governor Youngkin said he would support would have allowed _at least_ 94% of abortions across the state to continue.

But Democrats didn’t back down from attacking him.

So, Governor Youngkin’s genius political move managed to energize his enemies while deflating his base – which virtually always results in lower turnout.

But the strongest pro-life candidates across Virginia did just fine.

So, what’s the deal then? Why are so many Republicans running away from the abortion issue?

It’s because the blood-money filled pockets of the Abortion Lobby are much comfier than standing up for the lives of the preborn.

And the worst part is, if we don’t stop these pro-abortion Republicans from spreading, then they could very well end up doing to the 2024 elections what they did last week in Ohio, Virginia, and Kentucky!

So, the sooner these people are removed from power **_THE BETTER_!**

But I need your help if we’re going to do it.

**[So, could you please make your most generous contribution to _Students for Life Action_ so we can hold these traitor Republicans accountable for trying to tank the pro-life movement](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-sjulrit-duchtdja-i/)?**

Pro-Life Friend, if sellout Republicans like Senator Riepe want to fight. . . **so be it.**

We aren’t holding back on them. . .

Thanks for everything you do for Life.

For Life,

Kristan Hawkins
President, Students for Life Action

P.S. – Many Republicans are running scared from the fight for Life, convinced that fighting to save lives is tantamount to political suicide.

These so-called “Republicans” are costing the pro-life movement BIG TIME, some even going as far as to work against us, all while claiming to be pro-life so they can get our vote!

**[So, could you please make your most generous contribution to _Students for Life Action_ so we can hold these traitor Republicans accountable for trying to tank the pro-life movement](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-sjulrit-duchtdja-d/)?**

The Constitution established a limited government in which the **people** ruled through their elected officials. Under this form of government, America became the freest and most prosperous nation in history.

This sponsored message from Conservative Liberty Wire is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=8a2d6d4b564040299cd7660354ed98ed&_e=j6Um1tmlCzDpDP-ld0LcFJKEFCZzjfZd_eI-EOAMVL97KtqEmZ5J4A3e8dFAH2d5vuAgnkkXogtFnRRWw6ej0Qmdydev229ZK66myJW6xu3kktrzB12z6ftbG1WY8XLNfWGUZmV_DHGAZbyVoYcCG4Wucul1UGMcYjxnLwHHcN8YRlMe_EdBUT7cYI7kedSSi2ZOaIrUCBGYfbo_tymbGUUQuNQEqjjY4V8Gc4o3h7-vp0F3vCTuM6NUeHKRZIzc3PvkKdS__Q4Y-OGrlu-zDVQBOhvnQq9c-4b6kvcYUNBBBD0q7wAuLDTvbHinMmBGBYQXuD_HMbzvc3GBXWCUKZpf7wklmvnsDIJgGMmD1WRgZP0TSXx4p_gnckT1SGOHKh1wcoAnv6Hfhy1BrE2NSoSQRIhv3p2ccKoJy1rw2dI%3D) Dear Fellow American,
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us. This fact means that we're losing more and more living memory of the greatest armed conflict in human history, which makes the study of World War II even more important.
To this end, Hillsdale College has produced an online course entitled "The Second World Wars."

body:

| | Good news in Georgia, where Major League Baseball is restoring the All-Star Game for 2025. It’s a welcome reminder that our fight to protect voter integrity laws can combat inflammatory falsehoods like President Biden’s scandalous claim that Georgia in 2021 enacted Jim Crow 2.0. And RITE is doing just that. In the past few days, RITE PAC has defeated Marc Elias in two more cases, protecting the integrity of elections in New Hampshire and Florida. These important wins halt activist attempts to undermine the state’s authority to regulate elections and dissolve identification measures that prevent noncitizen voting and other illegal conduct. Meanwhile, in Wisconsin, RITE filed a brief to dismiss a dangerous case, again brought by Marc Elias, who is trying to eliminate rules that safeguard mail voting. ⬇️ ⬇️ ⬇️

# **RITE PAC Defeats Elias, Defends New Hampshire’s Voter ID Law **
A New Hampshire court ruled in favor of RITE PAC, the New Hampshire GOP, the RNC, and New Hampshire’s secretary of state and attorney general, stating that activists backed by Marc Elias had no basis to challenge New Hampshire’s voter identification laws. The court rejected activists' attempts to upend state election law and said that the plaintiffs failed to identify how anyone could be harmed by a law requiring photo identification for people trying to register to vote on election day. ([Read More](https://riteusa.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=dc5917dfc5aa19cc3795efbb2&id=832c36ed3d&e=ea91f782ea))

# **RITE PAC Wins****in Florida, Court Dismisses Elias Challenge **

RITE PAC, the Florida Secretary of State, and RNC won a significant victory in the Northern District of Florida as the court dismissed a complaint lodged by activists represented by Elias Law Group. The complaint falsely alleged that Florida’s voter registration process violates the Civil Rights Act by requiring a physical signature. The U.S. District Court for the Northern District of Florida ruled that the Civil Rights Act, a venerable law enacted to prevent the egregious acts of outright disenfranchisement of the Jim Crow era, does not apply to Florida’s ordinary, commonsense requirement that people actually sign their voter registration forms. RITE PAC’s win is a significant setback for the left’s efforts to misapply the Civil Rights Act to undermine election integrity. The activist plaintiffs have appealed, and RITE PAC looks forward to shutting down their frivolous legal arguments in that court too. ([Read More](https://riteusa.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=dc5917dfc5aa19cc3795efbb2&id=c669fb810d&e=ea91f782ea))

# **RITE D efends Wisconsin's Absentee Voting Laws against Marc Elias-backed Challenge **

RITE has filed a brief to counter a concerning effort by Marc Elias to dismantle absentee voting laws. RITE’s brief explains that Wisconsin’s longstanding witness requirement for mail ballots complies with federal law because the witness simply confirms that the voter has complied with the secret ballot process. Moreover, any voter who wishes to avoid a witness requirement can vote in-person.

The brief points out that the plaintiffs’ interpretation of the law would have a disastrous impact, as it would overturn "nearly every state law requiring that voters complete or sign or attest to a fact on their ballots."([Read More](https://riteusa.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=dc5917dfc5aa19cc3795efbb2&id=189061345f&e=ea91f782ea))

## RITE IN THE NEWS

**Court: Democrats Have No Evidence To Challenge New Hampshire’s Voter ID Law **
([The Federalist](https://riteusa.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=dc5917dfc5aa19cc3795efbb2&id=a7a4f6e55f&e=ea91f782ea), November 6, 2023)
_“Voter ID laws do not harm eligible voters, instead, they identify those people ineligible to vote, including non-citizens,” RITE President Derek Lyons said in a statement celebrating Wednesday’s ruling. “Every case rejecting activists’ attempts to upend state election law helps restore voters’ confidence in the ballot box.” _

**Court: Democrats Have No Evidence Florida’s Voter Registration Process Is Illegal **
([The Federalist](https://riteusa.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=dc5917dfc5aa19cc3795efbb2&id=82b57fb531&e=ea91f782ea), November 1, 2023)

_“The Civil Rights Act does many things, but it obviously does not ban the simple act of signing your voter registration, which is what the activists are alleging as part of a nationwide effort to degrade the integrity of our elections,” RITE PAC Vice President May Mailman said in a statement. “RITE PAC will continue to defend democratically enacted election laws because American citizens deserve elections run by law, not well-financed plaintiffs.” _

These important wins halt activist attempts to undermine the state’s authority to regulate elections and dissolve identification measures that prevent noncitizen voting and other illegal conduct. Meanwhile, in Wisconsin, RITE filed a brief to dismiss a dangerous case, again brought by Marc Elias, who is trying to eliminate rules that safeguard mail voting. ⬇️ ⬇️ ⬇️ RITE PAC Defeats Elias, Defends New Hampshire’s Voter ID Law A New Hampshire court ruled in favor of RITE PAC, the New Hampshire GOP, the RNC, and New Hampshire’s secretary of state and attorney general, stating that activists backed by Marc Elias had no basis to challenge New Hampshire’s voter identification laws. The court rejected activists' attempts to upend state election law and said that the plaintiffs failed to identify how anyone could be harmed by a law requiring photo identification for people trying to register to vote on election day. () RITE PAC Winsin Florida, Court Dismisses Elias Challenge RITE PAC, the Florida Secretary of State, and RNC won a significant victory in the Northern District of Florida as the court dismissed a complaint lodged by activists represented by Elias Law Group. The complaint falsely alleged that Florida’s voter registration process violates the Civil Rights Act by requiring a physical signature. The U.S. District Court for the Northern District of Florida ruled that the Civil Rights Act, a venerable law enacted to prevent the egregious acts of outright disenfranchisement of the Jim Crow era, does not apply to Florida’s ordinary, commonsense requirement that people actually sign their voter registration forms. RITE PAC’s win is a significant setback for the left’s efforts to misapply the Civil Rights Act to undermine election integrity. The activist plaintiffs have appealed, and RITE PAC looks forward to shutting down their frivolous legal arguments in that court too. () RITE D efends Wisconsin's Absentee Voting Laws against Marc Elias-backed Challenge RITE has filed a brief to counter a concerning effort by Marc Elias to dismantle absentee voting laws. RITE’s brief explains that Wisconsin’s longstanding witness requirement for mail ballots complies with federal law because the witness simply confirms that the voter has complied with the secret ballot process. Moreover, any voter who wishes to avoid a witness requirement can vote in-person. The brief points out that the plaintiffs’ interpretation of the law would have a disastrous impact, as it would overturn "nearly every state law requiring that voters complete or sign or attest to a fact on their ballots."() RITE IN THE NEWS Court: Democrats Have No Evidence To Challenge New Hampshire’s Voter ID Law (, November 6, 2023) “Voter ID laws do not harm eligible voters, instead, they identify those people ineligible to vote, including non-citizens,” RITE President Derek Lyons said in a statement celebrating Wednesday’s ruling. “Every case rejecting activists’ attempts to upend state election law helps restore voters’ confidence in the ballot box.” Court: Democrats Have No Evidence Florida’s Voter Registration Process Is Illegal (, November 1, 2023) “The Civil Rights Act does many things, but it obviously does not ban the simple act of signing your voter registration, which is what the activists are alleging as part of a nationwide effort to degrade the integrity of our elections,” RITE PAC Vice President May Mailman said in a statement. “RITE PAC will continue to defend democratically enacted election laws because American citizens deserve elections run by law, not well-financed plaintiffs.” | | | | | | | | Copyright © 2023 Restoring Integrity and Trust in Elections, All rights reserved.

Friend This Friday, I will be joined by the Schiller Institute's Marcia Merry Baker and Jason Ross, both of whom recently returned from an extraordinary conference held in Kabul, Afghanistan titled, “Operation Ibn Sina: The Coming Afghan Economic Miracle.” The conference, which brought together over 500 people including participation by officials from the ministries of the Islamic Emirate of Afghanistan, was comprised of day-long workshops in eight basic areas: agriculture and water, health, energy, industry and labor, credit and national banking, transportation, education, and culture. We will discuss the forward-looking approach of this war-ravaged nation as compared to the lack of vision exhibited by the non-leadership of the United States today. Given the horrific breakdown of the U.S. economy, there is ample opportunity to employ the latent talents of our people to develop our nation. Fellow American,

The most important things in life are faith, family, and freedom. That's not just a slogan, these happen to be the foundations of our great country. That is why I am fighting every day to preserve them.

**Faith.** Our nation began with the bold declaration that all men are created equal by God, and that our rights derive from Him and not the government. The founders insisted that faith must remain central to our national identity because, as George Washington summarized, "religion and morality are indispensable supports" of our republic. Like so many American households through the generations, in our house we instill faith in the hearts of our children, serve God, and serve people.

**Family.** Stable, happy families are the basis of any thriving society, and public policy should always acknowledge this obvious truth. Strengthening the nuclear family should be a top priority, and government should get out of the way and respect parental rights. Kelly and I have been very intentional about passing along the values of hard work, honor, and sacrifice to our children, just as our parents passed them along to us. For nearly two and a half centuries, this has been the American way.

**Freedom.** It is a self-evident truth that God endows all of us with inherent freedoms, such as the natural and unalienable rights to life, liberty, conscience, and the ability to pursue happiness, own property, build wealth and defend ourselves and our families. The purpose of government is to secure these rights, and the ideas we advance should always aim to maintain and increase the liberty of the American people. I’ve devoted my life and career to fighting for those fundamental freedoms and traditional values, first in the courts as a constitutional law attorney, and now in the Congress.

[**This is a simple truth:**](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/uu3mrWQvmrcsBnbA8pY61A~~/AARclAA~/RgRnOgoYP0SaaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUud2lucmVkLmNvbS9taWtlam9obnNvbi9iaW8tcGEtcj9zYz0yMDIzMTAyNl9NSk9ITlNPTl9FRV9QQV9CSU9fUkVWX1JPTiZ1dG1fdGM9Uk9OLTIwMjMxMTE3JnV0bV9zb3VyY2U9cmV2JnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPWJpb1cDc3BjQgplVdJgV2WLzEv_UhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAAA~~) America is the freest, most powerful, most successful nation in the history of world - but we cannot maintain that status if we are led by politicians who hate the very foundations that made us who we are!

[** SUPPORT MIKE JOHNSON > **](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/uu3mrWQvmrcsBnbA8pY61A~~/AARclAA~/RgRnOgoYP0SaaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUud2lucmVkLmNvbS9taWtlam9obnNvbi9iaW8tcGEtcj9zYz0yMDIzMTAyNl9NSk9ITlNPTl9FRV9QQV9CSU9fUkVWX1JPTiZ1dG1fdGM9Uk9OLTIwMjMxMTE3JnV0bV9zb3VyY2U9cmV2JnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPWJpb1cDc3BjQgplVdJgV2WLzEv_UhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAAA~~)

Right now in America, children are being taught in many schools to be ashamed of their country and themselves. The pledge is being taken out of school because it mentions God. Free speech is being censored and silenced right before our eyes. Democrats are fighting for the right to elective abortion right up to the moment of birth. Unelected, unaccountable bureaucrats are seeking control of almost every aspect of our lives.

**This is simply un-American, and we must stop the madness.**

We must elect more leaders who make decisions based on American values with an emphasis on God, family, and country. It’s the only way to preserve the blessings we have been given here.

[**Today, to continue to help lead this critical fight, I need your financial support – to restore our country and defend our values. Fellow American, we have a chance to save our country from the radical Left that is aiming to destroy it, but we’re running out of time. I made a promise when I was first elected to do what is best for our country, and for Louisiana, and I intend to keep that promise. It’s why I have been a trusted ally of President Donald Trump, who selected me for critical positions and endorsed all of my campaigns. It’s also why I was elected by my colleagues to serve as Vice Chairman of the House Republican Conference – one of seven elected leadership positions for Republicans in the House – and to chair the Subcommittee on the Constitution and Civil Liberties in the prestigious Judiciary Committee.

We are working in Congress every day to defend our conservative way of life and lead the fight for freedom, [**but we cannot do it alone.**](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/uu3mrWQvmrcsBnbA8pY61A~~/AARclAA~/RgRnOgoYP0SaaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUud2lucmVkLmNvbS9taWtlam9obnNvbi9iaW8tcGEtcj9zYz0yMDIzMTAyNl9NSk9ITlNPTl9FRV9QQV9CSU9fUkVWX1JPTiZ1dG1fdGM9Uk9OLTIwMjMxMTE3JnV0bV9zb3VyY2U9cmV2JnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPWJpb1cDc3BjQgplVdJgV2WLzEv_UhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAAA~~)

[**If you are committed to keeping the House from the radical Democrats who are self-serving and want to turn America into a socialist country, then I need your support today.**](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/uu3mrWQvmrcsBnbA8pY61A~~/AARclAA~/RgRnOgoYP0SaaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUud2lucmVkLmNvbS9taWtlam9obnNvbi9iaW8tcGEtcj9zYz0yMDIzMTAyNl9NSk9ITlNPTl9FRV9QQV9CSU9fUkVWX1JPTiZ1dG1fdGM9Uk9OLTIwMjMxMTE3JnV0bV9zb3VyY2U9cmV2JnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPWJpb1cDc3BjQgplVdJgV2WLzEv_UhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAAA~~)

The path we’re on currently will lead us to destruction. But that outcome is not inevitable. We still have the ability to turn this country around-- IF conscientious conservatives across America will stand up RIGHT NOW.

We MUST act, and we must do so today.

Strengthening the nuclear family should be a top priority, and government should get out of the way and respect parental rights. Kelly and I have been very intentional about passing along the values of hard work, honor, and sacrifice to our children, just as our parents passed them along to us. For nearly two and a half centuries, this has been the American way. Freedom. It is a self-evident truth that God endows all of us with inherent freedoms, such as the natural and unalienable rights to life, liberty, conscience, and the ability to pursue happiness, own property, build wealth and defend ourselves and our families. The purpose of government is to secure these rights, and the ideas we advance should always aim to maintain and increase the liberty of the American people. I’ve devoted my life and career to fighting for those fundamental freedoms and traditional values, first in the courts as a constitutional law attorney, and now in the Congress. ~~ America is the freest, most powerful, most successful nation in the history of world - but we cannot maintain that status if we are led by politicians who hate the very foundations that made us who we are! ~~ Right now in America, children are being taught in many schools to be ashamed of their country and themselves. The pledge is being taken out of school because it mentions God. Free speech is being censored and silenced right before our eyes. Democrats are fighting for the right to elective abortion right up to the moment of birth. Unelected, unaccountable bureaucrats are seeking control of almost every aspect of our lives. This is simply un-American, and we must stop the madness. We must elect more leaders who make decisions based on American values with an emphasis on God, family, and country. It’s the only way to preserve the blessings we have been given here. ~~ ~~ Fellow American, we have a chance to save our country from the radical Left that is aiming to destroy it, but we’re running out of time. I’m not sure what version of America we will leave to our kids if we continue down this path. ~~ I made a promise when I was first elected to do what is best for our country, and for Louisiana, and I intend to keep that promise. It’s why I have been a trusted ally of President Donald Trump, who selected me for critical positions and endorsed all of my campaigns. It’s also why I was elected by my colleagues to serve as Vice Chairman of the House Republican Conference – one of seven elected leadership positions for Republicans in the House – and to chair the Subcommittee on the Constitution and Civil Liberties in the prestigious Judiciary Committee. We are working in Congress every day to defend our conservative way of life and lead the fight for freedom, ~~ ~~ ~~ The path we’re on currently will lead us to destruction. But that outcome is not inevitable. We still have the ability to turn this country around-- IF conscientious conservatives across America will stand up RIGHT NOW. We MUST act, and we must do so today. ~~ Thank you for all you do, and God bless. ~~ Mike Johnson Speaker of the House | MIKE JOHNSON * Mike is a dedicated husband and father of four, as well as a constitutional law attorney who has devoted his life and career to fighting for the fundamental freedoms and traditional values that have always been a priority to the people of Louisiana. ~~ | PAID FOR BY MIKE JOHNSON FOR LOUISIANA Restore Our Nation PO Box 1177 Fort Collins, CO 80522 | ~~_
