## Newspapers' Demise Hits Local Towns
One-third of America's local newspapers have disappeared in the last 20 years, a new study shows. There are roughly 6,000 newspapers left in the U.S. today, down from nearly 9,000 in 2005 ([See Map](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx8kLGO6yAQRb8Gd7aYwQaloHiNu7x2S4t4hnhWxFjAxtm_X2U_YJvbXOkc6Xxcl2uQJPv9f3iwbzEvYW3y5CXJk6O8FoAeXI9mGTvykRnZdOzBaY0TGgfd5uNIcbIIzuJkw42AdLBxskBGI6zUiUeNBgAcuNHqy-CInaHVXHBkfXMXNWomabkMn1n2tnFM3_nJZVjzo0t-a-2oyvxTOCucz_Mcwktyfb8K5zdb4QzwHqtw3vmsRzi41J54TbJzvzHduY9fO9W-cOVQ1q0rno5TUpJqnRr1_REk_Rrb3yF-AgAA__-6QGH6)). The trend goes deeper than the overall numbers suggest; many local news operations are actually ["ghost newspapers,"](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx8kL1uhSAcR58GNwwfXtGBoYvb7drRIPz0_hsUA_Tavn3TpnPXkzOcnLf7fHcU6dhe3Q5b1zQ7X-mJOdITK33OUnJpuNJz1wS7Agq6gZVGCHVT2sjmYft-vOlBr96N2i_LYjCEm1mNwjD4zviGrBJKSymNNF0vxtYEGB28HlUHsZiRdQKBasrte6KjPrDGr_REbn3am2gftZ6F6RemJqam67raAldrRKUd5UdiakonHZQOpia3I5N3hR-4Cg8oyLXwLaeLjo3_8dOdyNzHVD4yCnfeIyK7CqamJttwXhQjld6wTmy7o_jbUv9f9B0AAP__Yt1vMw) published with zero local staff by national chains such as Gannett and Lee Enterprises. And of the 6,000 newspapers left, 5,000 only produce weekly editions. Don't miss our sponsor today, ! | Newspapers' Demise Hits Local Towns One-third of America's local newspapers have disappeared in the last 20 years, a new study shows. There are roughly 6,000 newspapers left in the U.S. today, down from nearly 9,000 in 2005 (). The trend goes deeper than the overall numbers suggest; many local news operations are actually published with zero local staff by national chains such as Gannett and Lee Enterprises. And of the 6,000 newspapers left, 5,000 only produce weekly editions. According to the study, a drop in advertising dollars is largely to blame for the shutdowns, and most of the towns that lose a local newspaper don't get a replacement--print or digital. # FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE
NOVEMBER 16, 2023
#
CONTACT: press@kevinfaulconer.com

**Associated General Contractors (AGC) of San Diego Endorse Former Mayor Kevin Faulconer For Supervisor**
SAN DIEGO, CA -- Former San Diego Mayor Kevin Faulconer, candidate for San Diego County Supervisor, announced the endorsement of the San Diego Chapter of The Associated General Contractors.
The Associated General Contractors (AGC) of San Diego is a critical voice for the construction industry whose mission is to promote opportunity, free enterprise, skill, integrity and responsibility among San Diego’s construction professionals.
**“Kevin Faulconer is what San Diego county needs to protect our small businesses” said Dustin Steiner, Vice President, of Government Affairs of AGC San Diego. “Kevin has a proven track record of bringing common sense policies to San Diego and helping our small businesses grow. We are confident Kevin will bring this common sense to the county level, and stop the government overreach happening in our communities, threatening to crush small businesses.”**
**“It is a privilege to receive the endorsement of Associated General Contractors of San Diego,” said Former San Diego Mayor Kevin Faulconer. “As Mayor, I worked with our local communities and small business to tear down red tape and overregulation that made it impossible for our local businesses to flourish. As Supervisor, you can count on me to continue championing reforms that make our small businesses easier, not harder, to operate. Small businesses keep our economy moving and we will do whatever possible to help them not hinder them.”**
As Mayor of San Diego, Faulconer changed the City of San Diego’s entire approach to housing regulation, treating housing as “essential” while making it faster and easier to build in areas that wanted new housing and adopting reforms that cut unnecessary barriers that stood in the way of progress. Under his leadership, the City removed expensive parking minimums and increased citywide housing capacity by 100,000 units after completing 16 community plan updates – more than any administration in City history.
Former San Diego Mayor Kevin Faulconer is a proven leader with a proven record working to enact common sense solutions to solve some of the region’s most significant issues, including housing, homelessness, and public safety.
###

Elections like that give me hope. Hope for a future where all women have access to life saving health care. And a future where all women have the choice of when and if they have a family.

**You know what else gives me hope? My husband’s bid for governor.** Ryan is a staunch believer in personal liberties and having control over your own body. I know that with him as governor our choices as women and our privacy will be respected.

But that’s on the line if Gianforte is elected to serve another term. He’s already restricted access to abortion, signing a whole slate of anti-choice bills earlier this year. And he’ll take it even further if he can by rewriting our constitution, which enshrines our rights to personal privacy, including access to abortion.

clean_body: | = Hi friend, Today, I want to share some of my personal story with you and highlight how we have the chance to make history in Arizona’s 1st Congressional District. If elected, I would be the first Latina to ever represent Arizona in Congress. I am a proud first generation Cuban American. My parents fled Fidel Castro’s communist Cuba for a better life for me and my siblings. Now, their daughter is running for Congress. It was anything but easy for my family. My father often worked multiple jobs, and my mother sewed buttons and zippers in a factory all to put dinner on the table. My parents' sacrifices for us taught me the power of hard work, the importance of fairness, and that family and community is everything. I know all too well what a dictatorship does to families and communities. At this moment, when far-right extremism is surging across the country, I am standing strong in defense of our democracy and our fundamental rights. My opponent David Schweikert continues to align himself with the far-right reaches of the GOP. # **A Message from the Chairwoman**
---
| | ** _Heading Into '24_**
---
Friends, As you know, this week the Indiana GOP hosted a big party to celebrate our historic 2023 wins and get ready for 2024. Hundreds of grassroots leaders from across the state came together for our Fall Reception, and the room was buzzing with excitement and optimism. As we discussed Wednesday evening, while the Indiana GOP might have just broken another record for elected Republican mayors, we aren't resting. We have pivoted our focus to the all important 2024 election cycle. This means we plan to finish this year strong in terms of fundraising and party building and jump into next year. As I said from the stage Wednesday night, we are going to be extremely focused on continuing to build and strengthen our party from the grassroots up. Together, we can continue to win in Indiana, and take the party to new heights. So, as we get ready for Thanksgiving week, I ask that you take a little time and connect with your county party or [reach out to us directly](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/df2c03f75311b6383947229f28c3afba/98a8031eea2f4f40c3d6b838967d376c/40313 "https://www.indiana.gop/join-team"). As we head into 2024, it is going to take all of us to make next year another historic year for the Indiana GOP. As always, thank you for all you do. I am looking forward to seeing you out on the road.
---
---
Chairwoman Anne F. Hathaway
---

Gen. Dale Lyles landed in Kenya today to visit Hoosier National Guard soldiers deployed since April 2023. “As Hoosiers prepare to gather around the Thanksgiving dinner table and reflect on all we’re grateful for, please include the men and women serving in Indiana’s National Guard,” Gov. Holcomb said. “They serve us at home in urgent times and far away when the orders arrive. So this year, while you huddle up with friends and family and celebrate your own family traditions, remember many of our Guard families are separated from one another while defending our values and way of life. Meeting Hoosier Guardsmen stationed in Kenya and seeing their dedication to our state and country firsthand, I’m proudly reminded, our freedom is not free, and it’s their dedication that pays the cost in full. Indeed, we have much to be thankful for.” **What else happened this week?****Gov. Whitten regarding the university’s response to allegations of antisemitism within Indiana University Student Government.** **Congressman Jim Baird's**[Quantum](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/df2c03f75311b6383947229f28c3afba/bf3e82ca32d518f6c3d6b838967d376c/40313) Instrumentation for Science & Engineering Act was included in the wider National Quantum Reauthorization Act. **Congresswoman Victoria Spartz**[attended](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/df2c03f75311b6383947229f28c3afba/71b1b35cb04eacf4c3d6b838967d376c/40313) this week's historic “March for Israel.” **Congressman Greg Pence** [joined](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/df2c03f75311b6383947229f28c3afba/1164b1100ce3f4ebc3d6b838967d376c/40313) Tony Katz. **Congressman Larry Bucshon**[visited](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/df2c03f75311b6383947229f28c3afba/b20031c888b043b7c3d6b838967d376c/40313) Indiana National Guard troops at Camp Simba in Manda Bay, Kenya, over Veterans Day weekend.** ** **Congresswoman Erin Houchin's**[asked](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/df2c03f75311b6383947229f28c3afba/4a13074db4142bc9c3d6b838967d376c/40313) how H.R. 5893 supports NASA and our mission to return to the moon.

body:
As my first order of business...

| |
---
| | | My fellow Americans - this is Mike Johnson.

**It is an honor to be your Speaker of the U.S. House of Representatives.**

I want to make myself crystal clear from day one:

**[I work for you, the American People.](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zvt65t6f744scbtfrpjs1aks0igv9vd89ca364io_rp22sh2s8i6eo30c9hm2o74s5h2bs "I work for you, the American People.")**

My first order of business is speaking with YOU. I want to know about your priorities as we close out the year and what you'd like to see us do next. Working together is our best chance to defeat the Radical Left.

I just launched my **[NEW SPEAKER SURVEY](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zfv5l4n4n1dhi0hcar82iv6ek23hjmpctipv5dv0_rp22sh2s8i6eo30c9hm2o74s5h2bs "NEW SPEAKER SURVEY")** - this gives you a chance to communicate directly with me. I'm humbly asking you to provide any feedback you'd be willing to share. This is very important to me.

_The only thing I ask is for you to respond as soon as you get this. I know you 're busy... but things are changing by the minute so I'd like your feedback right away. _
---
**[](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zia1hancr3q9leiktapdhl3uinue1h8ih2ncqqb0_rp22sh2s8i6eo30c9hm2o74s5h2bs)[**TAKE MY NEW SPEAKER SURVEY**](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2znc9d75lco0ca8eddqnanrcucdiv920hfb9bfd0g_rp22sh2s8i6eo30c9hm2o74s5h2bs) _**
---
I will be blunt with you.

The challenges facing our country will take courage and determination to overcome. Not just from me, but from you too. This will not be easy. We need your best effort and giving up is simply NOT an option - not if we want to save this great country.

The power to bring our country roaring back is in your hands. We just have to rise to the occasion - and that starts with having an open and honest dialogue. Don't spare my feelings. Be honest. I want to know exactly how you feel.

**[That's why I respectfully ask you for a few minutes to guide your House Majority where YOU want it to go.](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zfe094el77kdvsntt6ko6aafokj0cv1ttur310h0_rp22sh2s8i6eo30c9hm2o74s5h2bs "That’s why I respectfully ask you for a few minutes to guide your House Majority where YOU want it to go.")**

More from me soon,

**Mike Johnson**
Speaker of the House

My name is Nikki Haley. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I'm running for President of the United States.

I'm running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago - an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again.

I'm running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something - that we do love this country.

I'm running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I'm doing this for my son who's a senior in college and shouldn't have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn't believe in just to get an A.

I'm running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer.

_**I 'm running for President because we have a country to save! **_

I've seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden's leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better.

**As governor, I was dubbed a "jobs governor"** because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic recovery.

**At the UN I fought for America,** made sure our allies knew we had their backs and stood up to murderers and dictators to let them know that America was taking names.

I know how to make America strong and proud because I've done it before. **And I 'll do it as your next President. **

As President, I'll revitalize our economy, support small businesses, stop Washington's spending sprees, protect our border, champion school choice, and save America's future.

clean_body: Would you want to be flown out to the fourth presidential debate, Friend? %recipient.md5hash% | | | | | | Would you want to be flown out to the fourth presidential debate, Friend? "I wanted to make sure YOU were among the first people I emailed so you had a chance to enter the RNC's debate contest!" All you have to do is send a donation of any amount today and you will be entered for a chance to win: -> TWO free tickets to the fourth presidential debate. -> Airfare for two. -> Hotel accommodations. I would love for you to witness the fourth presidential debate in person, take part in history, and make memories that will last a lifetime. "I'm urging you to take advantage of this once-in-a-lifetime opportunity." | | Thank you so much for your support. I hope to see you in Tuscaloosa! My very best, | Nikki Haley | | | | | | | | "NikkiHaleyMerch" | | "Claim Your Mug" | | More About Nikki Haley | "NikkiHaleyPodium" My name is Nikki Haley. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I'm running for President of the United States. I'm running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago - an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again. I'm running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something - that we do love this country. I'm running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I'm doing this for my son who's a senior in college and shouldn't have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn't believe in just to get an A. I'm running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer. I 'm running for President because we have a country to save! I've seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden's leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better. name: Gene Karpinski, LCV
subject: [3X MATCH ACTIVE]. The House just put the environment in serious jeopardy. We need to hear from you, Peter.
body:
Time sensitive

Peter - our Membership Drive deadline is a few days away, and we're reaching out because we haven't heard from you yet (renew your membership here and your contribution will be tripled https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/yAyZM- ).

The truth is your membership matters, and it's particularly critical right now.

Here's the situation: Earlier this month, Senator Joe Manchin backed away from a climate deal after months of negotiations, choosing to side with Big Oil and Republicans. It leaves the deal one vote short -- stalling any real action in Congress for now.

In response, we're redoubling our efforts on pushing the White House to act decisively on climate. The Biden administration has massive amounts of power to curb climate pollution - but that will only happen if the environmental movement makes it happen.

Right now, we're facing a critical test: the Biden administration is weighing a plan to block all new oil and gas drilling leases on public waters.

This could be huge -- and a decision is coming. Right now, we're organizing volunteers from all over the country to flood the administration with letters, pressuring Biden to hold to his promises.

Peter -- it's your membership support that makes victory possible here. But we have to do more. A group of donors has put together a fund to triple match every contribution before Sunday's membership deadline:

Can we count on your support? Claim your membership now - it only takes $5 >> https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/VXb6s8NYNwS_

The ban on new oil and gas leases is the first of many huge environmental decisions, Peter. And right now, we're pushing for serious action on so many fronts -- including:
Setting tight standards for power plants and other major emitters of climate pollution
Placing strict limits on air pollution to safeguard all communities Expediting requirements of 100% tailpipe pollution-free new cars by 2035 and trucks by 2040
Protecting communities from hazardous and super-polluting methane Conserving 30% of our public lands and waters by 2030 Declaring a climate emergency - and so much more. The best way you can help win each and every one of these fights right now is to claim your LCV membership - all it takes is a gift of $5 or more. https://links.messages.lcv.

Thank you, thank you, thank you, Peter. This is such a critical moment for the environment, and we're so fortunate to have you on the team.

Onward,

Gene Karpinski
President
League of Conservation Voters

This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. If this isn't the best email address at which to reach you, update your contact information https://www.pages08.net/leagueofconservationvoters/forms/ContactInformation?spMailingID=10246754&spUserID=NjA3MDU0MTAzNTc3S0&spJobID=MTg2MDM3MDg5MQS2&spReportId=MTg2MDM3MDg5MQS2. Peter, it’s James Carville, and I’m raging at the newest development out of Nevada: **A shady MAGA billionaire just poured $2 MILLION into this race to try and flip Nevada red.**
**I’m not going to mince words, Peter — national Republicans think they can BUY this seat.** Our razor-thin majority is hanging on by a single thread, and there’s no question that Mitch McConnell and his extremist cronies are going to spend every cent they can to take back the Senate.

name: Defend the Constitution
subject: Your thoughts on American Education
body:
You are an informed citizen--I believe that wholeheartedly.

This sponsored message from Defend the Constitution is on behalf of Hillsdale College
| | | [](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=052906522d0c49b98b783ec4af439691&_e=MLj67OOyB4q7msqqTKki8ITUTlrnWru0bqE8793mRGQqrDFtW93lxA4LskK5ZaEdRjohBKzwGRqmvsSuSLl8r66qGBR7B9ggocQ3C9novUA64D1gRB5UoboCxk8Rx2tT-btPMAs_9oXChHgFbBZjg0FlSpwc3UGBZ2SN6w_cIZO03tXoSPcanhhVy6rGsQ0ufWCujEMH98Y7tvBb5pbHusoDS8KavDBXmUpnQdkrBvoJxQhjl5Sqy0lGxymJ2QNcAd5XcFxTNCQC_pLpINx0BSTmJZet8AMmnbwRPyETvHabwn_lnkWpNY6oiEq46_enf4d9u-Hq-RZOj3mxtud1gDMKODIX6hsUg7-hroo_2tI8H_SM4-kR3MiWXxTaj2aDxm0-drolTZf0q-d-AJRHqg%3D%3D)

| | Good day, fellow American. You are an informed citizen--I believe that wholeheartedly. You love this country. subject: I’m honored to be your Speaker of the House
body:
As my first order of business...

| |
---
| | | My fellow Americans - this is Mike Johnson.

**It is an honor to be your Speaker of the U.S. House of Representatives.**

I want to make myself crystal clear from day one:

**[I work for you, the American People.](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=89fbe2a1ecb245eb995b74cce3f4e7be&_e=27v3ABjF473KcP_dp-0bJDGbUcPCINFM0UH5yqfYWyLBe-NcEeVgeYZzf7EEYVJUpfS-NlXL5vM8cy0rdfZOY4Ii0mSex3yaX_3rv5XFtjwowHm6pJP4sYQ1FvxQ9iRDi47kzTCfj37Nb98ZcpC2c6hpIKiS83CAHLRnSdaTfp1dFN21-yKTX-JCCi-QyGBrmi2Jpv-dyviO1X6q9VP0mb4yJVkbjUYj6V9C-Oy--NM4y-l5v1jshc1yYUxC_Zx6rqVzQH6vmkry_Fk3J0WB8QmNcHveV42WiPOgMsnn7M8FY-N7q8QWiYKKNnNdmpvo5P19wwHVC_3NMGgVVLLQ_dFMxQ4Z4POdcIHcNfWztBIiy5tHMSJyTw4WVIQaHsQziyphCMYwLAEvI4GP_vYwk8GMm5X3YdXDLDELbttiwOUot-CkuJHR_Fbp-MuLEnYNVlqx0DWBsEbjY8fc3b7G4Q%3D%3D "I work for you, the American People.")**

My first order of business is speaking with YOU. I want to know about your priorities as we close out the year and what you'd like to see us do next. Working together is our best chance to defeat the Radical Left.

I just launched my **[NEW SPEAKER SURVEY](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=89fbe2a1ecb245eb995b74cce3f4e7be&_e=27v3ABjF473KcP_dp-0bJDGbUcPCINFM0UH5yqfYWyLBe-NcEeVgeYZzf7EEYVJUpfS-NlXL5vM8cy0rdfZOY4Ii0mSex3yaX_3rv5XFtjwowHm6pJP4sYQ1FvxQ9iRDi47kzTCfj37Nb98ZcpC2c6hpIKiS83CAHLRnSdaTfp1dFN21-yKTX-JCCi-QyGBrmi2Jpv-dyviO1X6q9VP0mb4yJVkbjUYj6V9C-Oy--NM4y-l5v1jshc1yYUxC_Zx6rqVzQH6vmkry_Fk3J0WB8QmNcHveV42WiPOgMsnn7M8FY-N7q8QWiYKKNnNdmpvoCSr4EjyVn5_hvv7-TcYzf0W2JSQRHjc4VzBugLtaTmegsxHC17UTXGRbD35DCnB60WHDiZ8xDtDTDm4hQzYDFVYEGCwr0PqIdtf81lCyuD6GxLHXYJrlkoiBsHCy6jMM7oPAPtu2jN3uHxAuRdeWPg%3D%3D "NEW SPEAKER SURVEY")** - this gives you a chance to communicate directly with me. I'm humbly asking you to provide any feedback you'd be willing to share. This is very important to me.

_The only thing I ask is for you to respond as soon as you get this. I know you 're busy... but things are changing by the minute so I'd like your feedback right away. _

**[](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=89fbe2a1ecb245eb995b74cce3f4e7be&_e=27v3ABjF473KcP_dp-0bJDGbUcPCINFM0UH5yqfYWyLBe-NcEeVgeYZzf7EEYVJUpfS-NlXL5vM8cy0rdfZOY4Ii0mSex3yaX_3rv5XFtjwowHm6pJP4sYQ1FvxQ9iRDi47kzTCfj37Nb98ZcpC2c6hpIKiS83CAHLRnSdaTfp1dFN21-yKTX-JCCi-QyGBrmi2Jpv-dyviO1X6q9VP0mb4yJVkbjUYj6V9C-Oy--NM4y-l5v1jshc1yYUxC_Zx6rqVzQH6vmkry_Fk3J0WB8QmNcHveV42WiPOgMsnn7M8FY-N7q8QWiYKKNnNdmpvoIjxq0uoaW2PUwo3Q17sZS4Ymx9V3eogwGBuJZOw-20nXOP03Uex5jdZrQw9bqw2gfb4S2gkAvYcMzSFCPpRwjkPmTvyzsjVZkghbb44YbBh-2YjXz3E23OZUMoFOD0IEgUqXELk_jG88bhAeSGhV2g%3D%3D)[**TAKE MY NEW SPEAKER SURVEY**](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=89fbe2a1ecb245eb995b74cce3f4e7be&_e=27v3ABjF473KcP_dp-0bJDGbUcPCINFM0UH5yqfYWyLBe-NcEeVgeYZzf7EEYVJUpfS-NlXL5vM8cy0rdfZOY4Ii0mSex3yaX_3rv5XFtjwowHm6pJP4sYQ1FvxQ9iRDi47kzTCfj37Nb98ZcpC2c6hpIKiS83CAHLRnSdaTfp1dFN21-yKTX-JCCi-QyGBrmi2Jpv-dyviO1X6q9VP0mb4yJVkbjUYj6V9C-Oy--NM4y-l5v1jshc1yYUxC_Zx6rqVzQH6vmkry_Fk3J0WB8QmNcHveV42WiPOgMsnn7M8FY-N7q8QWiYKKNnNdmpvoh8QIxKnfFj5vu-VVJhCIHz7m7yR493QMJtSzDUnGpJRxzepUcDK_kZYtzADcusHhsZDFi2VqaXuT0Mqv3COuNMg1HDAkOS-WeaJaCW5TEqTDbM5faAZBGngJkD9e9EjWDRL3zsImhxoeP_oGUnT-oQ%3D%3D) _**
---
I will be blunt with you.

The challenges facing our country will take courage and determination to overcome. Not just from me, but from you too. This will not be easy. We need your best effort and giving up is simply NOT an option - not if we want to save this great country.

The power to bring our country roaring back is in your hands. We just have to rise to the occasion - and that starts with having an open and honest dialogue. Don't spare my feelings. Be honest. I want to know exactly how you feel.

**[That's why I respectfully ask you for a few minutes to guide your House Majority where YOU want it to go.](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=89fbe2a1ecb245eb995b74cce3f4e7be&_e=27v3ABjF473KcP_dp-0bJDGbUcPCINFM0UH5yqfYWyLBe-NcEeVgeYZzf7EEYVJUpfS-NlXL5vM8cy0rdfZOY4Ii0mSex3yaX_3rv5XFtjwowHm6pJP4sYQ1FvxQ9iRDi47kzTCfj37Nb98ZcpC2c6hpIKiS83CAHLRnSdaTfp1dFN21-yKTX-JCCi-QyGBrmi2Jpv-dyviO1X6q9VP0mb4yJVkbjUYj6V9C-Oy--NM4y-l5v1jshc1yYUxC_Zx6rqVzQH6vmkry_Fk3J0WB8QmNcHveV42WiPOgMsnn7M8FY-N7q8QWiYKKNnNdmpvo00fJQweJ38f9aOLl8QAp5BVF0VzPsk5L_3M_DpwNkNrIiFiLbpdL_0kgjxTczh-soe8YL3Z0o_wBs6oSpqk1cRS0NQSDDmQO-dWpzQYqu2-vIYAkpPoyws07BEYj0aUWwMbbxPUST51SRolFGqfjAg%3D%3D "That’s why I respectfully ask you for a few minutes to guide your House Majority where YOU want it to go.")**

More from me soon,

**Mike Johnson**
Speaker of the House

body:
Alexandria is going to let you in on a little secret.
#
A lot of people across the political spectrum want to fear-monger about the idea of Democratic Socialism. So Alexandria broke it down, ‘ASMR’-style.
[Take a look at the video here. If you agree, please consider making a $5 contribution to power Alexandria’s re-election campaign today.](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20231117.8qPcy5&refcode=em20231117-5333-P_FND_EGR_GOL&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=5333%2E2526796%2EIbhRJp)
Alexandria doesn’t believe in the extreme pursuit of profit at any and all human or environmental cost. She believes in guaranteed healthcare for all, and tackling the climate crisis with a much more serious mobilization than what we’re doing now.
[](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20231117.8qPcy5&refcode=em20231117-5333-P_FND_EGR_GOL&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=5333%2E2526796%2EIbhRJp)
Democratic socialism means we value democracy and society over the love of capital. As opposed to loving capital more than we love the integrity of our democracy and society — which is what we have right now.
[People like to paint Alexandria as extreme, but the reality is that we’re fighting to protect what should be basic rights — things like healthcare and voting. Will you make a $5 contribution today to power Alexandria’s fight?](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20231117.8qPcy5&refcode=em20231117-5333-P_FND_EGR_GOL&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=5333%2E2526796%2EIbhRJp)

Team AOC

My fellow Americans - this is Mike Johnson.

| | | My fellow Americans - this is Mike Johnson.

_**[This is a longer email but I'm humbly asking you to read it start to finish.](http://links.fighttheswamp.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=ac02d36f3a16428fa3d4d621f4f093a3&_e=SqwQ3eyJc5EpqLYoNU-Zk_uPg4g3NFCy0uYAnSeW_nxFEkXu7HXI-sgnspmKM7UaH4KaKG46zugKVb8k1lQqAChz0xmfJWaEE1L5xLmBAcWK0BUqeyTFMPrtixVVhTPjzEC4pSsSGuNxLgeeBBqsMjR2R1Z4_MqqNjp5oPsafo8LhfDVa0rAg7qmmfN-m35_SsC3PGpPaQq7Pi9cavhszeDgqlfaTScLKGJLlNCKesBXM4ub4kl01Y6nBcDAQP7h49US_A1Zsytkhrrd0v2mbQhpQnykdBWW773IH8xXCSOw-Ea9eqeO7D42635K2gBFr-mxj4pCHWEhzWZ23ih4-cQ9AoIDTquUehWLgCAEGG2rhB33yLST-2yqD6M--11WUFez4jI3c6ZjCDycCGFY_A%3D%3D "This is a longer email but I’m humbly asking you to read it start to finish.")**_

Why? Because the moment I was elected Speaker by my Republican colleagues, the Radical Left IMMEDIATELY unleashed a coordinated, preplanned political hit job against me.
* The Liberal Media spun up hit piece after hit piece to smear me in the press - Biden's former Press Secretary even attacked me for being a Christian on MSNBC.
* Politico fired off this headline: _" Democrats rev up the opposition machine against Mike Johnson."_
* And I can't even begin to tell you how many Democrat fundraising emails and texts I saw in the minutes following the final vote - I'm bracing myself for the next FEC reports.

Look:

These vicious attacks are a dime a dozen in Washington. They don't intimidate me. _But I 'll let you in on a little secret: that's not _really_ the goal..._

The _real_ goal of this political ambush is two-fold: **1)** smear the good names of every House Republican to hurt them electorally, and **2)** scare Liberals enough to whip out their credit cards, fill in their info, and donate to Democrats.

**It 's about power and money. Nothing else.**

That's why it's mission-critical that we stand up for ourselves in critical moments like this. _**[So as one of my first moves as Speaker, I'm teaming up with my fellow Louisianian - Majority Leader Steve Scalise - to set a goal of raising one million dollars between now and the end of the month.](http://links.fighttheswamp.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=ac02d36f3a16428fa3d4d621f4f093a3&_e=SqwQ3eyJc5EpqLYoNU-Zk_uPg4g3NFCy0uYAnSeW_nxFEkXu7HXI-sgnspmKM7UaH4KaKG46zugKVb8k1lQqAChz0xmfJWaEE1L5xLmBAcWK0BUqeyTFMPrtixVVhTPjzEC4pSsSGuNxLgeeBBqsMjR2R1Z4_MqqNjp5oPsafo8LhfDVa0rAg7qmmfN-m35_SsC3PGpPaQq7Pi9cavhszeDgqlfaTScLKGJLlNCKesBXM4ub4kl01Y6nBcDAQP7h5hU2rzMPWuqyRcJJjvMK6susphX3K8KcLelCgwjGY7yVF9ha8aLNZfIwdtELIMqoXGxJpNMq3pFL4z-L7QS6s2EVbXsjdDr6NFJLHhAc1wtZGDznaFuagY5iZEUZp4-JN4LCy2FFVq-n4G-CpkUsFQ%3D%3D "So as one of my first moves as Speaker, I’m teaming up with my fellow Louisianian – Majority Leader Steve Scalise – to set a goal of raising one million dollars between now and the end of the month.")**_

It's ambitious. I get it. But that's the bare minimum we need to fully fund our campaign operations in battleground races across the country.

**If we fall short of that, we 'll be forced to SLASH our voter contact budgets, GUT our digital outreach efforts, and pull our ads OFF THE AIRWAVES. Nothing could be worse for our plans to defend and expand our slim House Majority.**

So here's my final pitch to you:

We urgently need your help. Not next week, not in the new year - right here and right now.

The difference between a strong Conservative Majority and one controlled by the Liberal Machine will come down to can't-miss fundraising goals just like this.

Let me make myself perfectly clear:

_I 'm not asking you to pitch in more than you can afford. If you can spare $50 or $100, I would be tremendously grateful. But if you can only spare $5 or $10, I would be equally appreciative._

_**[The ONLY thing I ask is for every Conservative in the country to chip in SOMETHING.](http://links.fighttheswamp.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=ac02d36f3a16428fa3d4d621f4f093a3&_e=SqwQ3eyJc5EpqLYoNU-Zk_uPg4g3NFCy0uYAnSeW_nxFEkXu7HXI-sgnspmKM7UaH4KaKG46zugKVb8k1lQqAChz0xmfJWaEE1L5xLmBAcWK0BUqeyTFMPrtixVVhTPjzEC4pSsSGuNxLgeeBBqsMjR2R1Z4_MqqNjp5oPsafo8LhfDVa0rAg7qmmfN-m35_SsC3PGpPaQq7Pi9cavhszeDgqlfaTScLKGJLlNCKesBXM4ub4kl01Y6nBcDAQP7hk5rWhQm3QlRgV1Zdd4NaDWBRyWCzdcyOTwFgZfvRuUQ2AozDYZMT_st4fmfcTbcGVU_pLUXT1Xkt_JFHnWtmcpxpuWXJ7beLdIDWvMNwu75UTfXGnkDBbGBgjh1omlZD5YsGgOC8D8Td38bA55z2yg%3D%3D "The ONLY thing I ask is for every Conservative in the country to chip in SOMETHING.")**_

Let me make myself perfectly clear: I 'm not asking you to pitch in more than you can afford. If you can spare $50 or $100, I would be tremendously grateful. Let that sink in...

_The RINOs can be just as nasty as the Democrats! At least you know the Democrats are out to get you. The RINOs pretend to be your friend only to stab you in the back!_

Why? Because the moment I was elected Speaker by my Republican colleagues, the Radical Left IMMEDIATELY unleashed a coordinated, preplanned political hit job against me.
* The Liberal Media spun up hit piece after hit piece to smear me in the press - Biden's former Press Secretary even attacked me for being a Christian on MSNBC.
* Politico fired off this headline: _" Democrats rev up the opposition machine against Mike Johnson."_
* And I can't even begin to tell you how many Democrat fundraising emails and texts I saw in the minutes following the final vote - I'm bracing myself for the next FEC reports.

Look:

These vicious attacks are a dime a dozen in Washington. They don't intimidate me. _But I 'll let you in on a little secret: that's not _really_ the goal..._

The _real_ goal of this political ambush is two-fold: **1)** smear the good names of every House Republican to hurt them electorally, and **2)** scare Liberals enough to whip out their credit cards, fill in their info, and donate to Democrats.

**It 's about power and money. Nothing else.**

That's why it's mission-critical that we stand up for ourselves in critical moments like this. _**[So as one of my first moves as Speaker, I'm teaming up with my fellow Louisianian - Majority Leader Steve Scalise - to set a goal of raising one million dollars between now and the end of the month.](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=1185401835c84172b8e38f84a262ac62&_e=v_WKTaaoxr-93KTaRcq9i0FL5q0u1lgq72FP0jeKF5m4T73EgihJkGPcWiNtkag-NMylQLfMIktGhzO_is6DHu9y89FKjkwxtGnu8env5wpvvS4c99AtNsvC9OFzixDxhQ4cI-TB-sTckzGfKRfy0jOVAux8SowlbeblMqMK0LALo18P31k12JPvegN2QFb2G6fiUIuN7OefplCN_ZYBO_aiiX8U147R76742He03LKyFtP9bKF4pwZjzgpQikq4DT1MTqc3MeN_ZMV1iGFGsJhAHlevT7Uk1mPO9G1clywPuiecowgEXt86FtVGZ-YAAAs1xCx_1Gb4vfB1SObowXKHHy3vIKOqDeOSFCqCpBa1j5w-Bcyn2FnX6FcFJ64gDxpMGq8unoXqPFR-xSugLCPphvq_1lMQiRbfjGITOwE%3D "So as one of my first moves as Speaker, I’m teaming up with my fellow Louisianian – Majority Leader Steve Scalise – to set a goal of raising one million dollars between now and the end of the month.")**_

It's ambitious. I get it. But that's the bare minimum we need to fully fund our campaign operations in battleground races across the country.

**If we fall short of that, we 'll be forced to SLASH our voter contact budgets, GUT our digital outreach efforts, and pull our ads OFF THE AIRWAVES. Nothing could be worse for our plans to defend and expand our slim House Majority.**

So here's my final pitch to you:

We urgently need your help. Not next week, not in the new year - right here and right now.

The difference between a strong Conservative Majority and one controlled by the Liberal Machine will come down to can't-miss fundraising goals just like this.

Let me make myself perfectly clear:

_I 'm not asking you to pitch in more than you can afford. If you can spare $50 or $100, I would be tremendously grateful. But if you can only spare $5 or $10, I would be equally appreciative._

_**[The ONLY thing I ask is for every Conservative in the country to chip in SOMETHING.](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=1185401835c84172b8e38f84a262ac62&_e=v_WKTaaoxr-93KTaRcq9i0FL5q0u1lgq72FP0jeKF5m4T73EgihJkGPcWiNtkag-NMylQLfMIktGhzO_is6DHu9y89FKjkwxtGnu8env5wpvvS4c99AtNsvC9OFzixDxhQ4cI-TB-sTckzGfKRfy0jOVAux8SowlbeblMqMK0LALo18P31k12JPvegN2QFb2G6fiUIuN7OefplCN_ZYBO_aiiX8U147R76742He03LKyFtP9bKF4pwZjzgpQikq4Cgyx05f8T9c-GJmv3AVagtAn7INBgsrtAzeXLPVYH9qts6tc5OOHJiK_urJ34V-G0xZohY4AcrPntpf_zpUFNabCK4WLBuzHdMDRL-aNkv1-gAx9AqtpQ6HhRphnEvy02T7x3oA5vkreAJX2zSrp6TXDF3RbYeJWZf9xnw1qvrc%3D "The ONLY thing I ask is for every Conservative in the country to chip in SOMETHING.")**_

body:
|
#
Peter, Ever since Republicans elected Mike Johnson as House Speaker, it feels like we’ve learned something new — and terrifying — about who he is and what he supports every day. From his support for a nationwide abortion ban to his extremist views about the LGBTQ+ community, it’s frightening that Mike Johnson was merely the House GOP’s “compromise” candidate. **But perhaps the most dangerous thing about Mike Johnson is that he is hell-bent on slashing Medicare, Medicaid, and Social Security as we know it — programs that millions of Americans rely on. And Mitch McConnell is right there with him.** If Senate Republicans win the majority in 2024, their MAGA extremist agenda will put Social Security, Medicare, and Medicaid up first on the chopping block. **It’s our job to make sure they don’t get the chance.** **[Please, join me in speaking out to demand that Congress protect Social Security, Medicare, and Medicaid by adding your name to my petition. body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

Ilhan Omar officially has a 2024 Democratic primary challenger in
Minnesota’s 5th congressional district.

Minneapolis city council member Don Samuels launched his rematch campaign
against Ilhan, whom he narrowly lost to in 2022 by a margin of less than
2,500 votes.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20231117-2-io.fo650m&refcode=em20231117-31907&amount=3&t=1001&akid=31907%2E1203867%2E28Kw2j ]We can’t waste a moment: will you rush a split contribution of
$3 or more right now to help Justice Democrats and Ilhan
fight back?

Ilhan’s repeat opponent is a centrist who accused her of having “a
predilection to divisiveness and conflict” because of her support for
criminal justice reform and calls for a ceasefire and release of all
hostages in Israel and Palestine.

In her two terms in Congress, Ilhan has been an unapologetic champion for
bold, progressive change and human rights. Samuels meanwhile led efforts
on the Minneapolis city council to block a groundbreaking measure that
would replace the police force with a public safety agency, after police
murdered George Floyd in 2020.

We already know corporate interests and dark money groups like AIPAC are
going to come out of the woodwork to support Ilhan’s opponent with huge
sums of money and attack ads, as she refuses to do their bidding in
Congress and challenges the status quo.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20231117-2-io.fo650m&refcode=em20231117-31907&amount=3&t=1002&akid=31907%2E1203867%2E28Kw2j ]Our movement cannot afford to lose this crucial Squad member in
Congress next year. Split a grassroots donation to Justice Democrats and
Ilhan’s campaign now to defend her!

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20231117-2-io.fo650m&refcode=em20231117-31907&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1021&akid=31907%2E1203867%2E28Kw2j ]Contribute $3

In solidarity,

Alexandra Rojas
Executive Director

this is a difficult time.

There are other ways to make an impact in support of peace and equality in

using [ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/139874?t=1023&akid=31907%2E1203867%2E28Kw2j ]Jewish Voice for Peace’s dialer here. Your voice matters in this
critical moment.

# 2023 November e-newsletter
News and information for District 5 in San Mateo County.
---
|
---
|
---
| **San Mateo County welcomes Chinese President Xi and President Biden for historic diplomatic meeting**
---
| Dear friends,
San Mateo County and the Filoli Estate will be memorialized forever for bringing President Joe Biden and Chinese President Xi Jinping together in a historic meeting Wednesday, Nov. 15 to ease tensions between the world’s two largest economies.

Our two nations need to find diplomatic solutions on issues including climate change, countering the fentanyl crisis, approaching artificial intelligence and restoring communication between our two militaries.
---
As a San Mateo County Supervisor, I am proud our incredible county and the historic Filoli Estate was the setting to bring our two nations closer together after President Xi and President Biden haven’t met face-to-face in a year.

As wars wage across the world, China and the United States met the moment in San Mateo County to work toward ending the downward spiral in diplomatic relations our two nations have faced.
---
| **San Mateo County stands united against hate** The San Mateo County Board of Supervisors declared Nov. 12-18 as United Against Hate Week at its meeting Tuesday, Nov. 14 in a proclamation I cosponsored with Board President Dave Pine.

The United Against Hate campaign was created by civic leaders in the Bay Area in 2017 in direct response to the sharp rise in expressions of hate in our communities, and United Against Hate Week emerged specifically from a poster campaign in response to white supremacist rallies that occurred in Berkeley and San Francisco in 2017.

The proclamation was presented to Kalimah Salahuddin, Vice President of the Jefferson Union High School Board of Trustees and board member on the San Mateo County Reach Coalition who spoke on dismantling systemic bias and long-standing barriers to access across our county.

United Against Hate Week is when communities, groups, individuals work together against hate, restore respect and civil discourse, embrace the strength of diversity and build inclusive and equitable safe communities for all.

A special thanks to the Office of Community Affairs Director Emma Gonzalez and the Immigrant Services Team for their continued work to ensure San Mateo County is a welcoming county for all - residents and visitors alike.
---
---
| **
Cities embrace projects to improve lives of older adults** If you wish to see and understand positive social change in a community, take a look at the Age-Friendly Cities initiative being undertaken in San Mateo County in partnership with the Center for Age-Friendly Excellence (CAFE).

I introduced the concept to the San Mateo County Board of Supervisors in March 2019 and want to enlighten you on the progress San Mateo County cities have made with support of Measure K funding over the past four years to become certified age friendly by the World Health Organization.

CAFE has provided expert technical assistance to the participating cities in San Mateo including Brisbane. CAFE organizes representative city task forces; conducts comprehensive qualitative and quantitative research on unmet needs; explores and leverages existing community strengths and offers policy and program recommendations.

With that, I am proud to announce that the cities of Pacifica, Daly City, Brisbane, Half Moon Bay, South San Francisco, Millbrae, Burlingame, San Mateo, Belmont, San Carlos, Hillsborough, Foster City, East Palo Alto, Redwood City and Colma are all certified with San Bruno and Atherton on track to be certified by the end of December.
---
| **
Grant supports business resource center for Daly City/Colma Chamber of Commerce**

I am honored to announce a significant one-time grant of district-discretionary Measure K funds of $75,000 to the Daly City/Colma Chamber of Commerce. This strategic investment will not only sustain its crucial operations but also establish a pivotal business resource center.

This initiative holds the potential to catalyze substantial economic development for the residents and businesses of Daly City and Colma, marking a substantial step toward a brighter, more prosperous future for businesses in these two cities.
---
| **
$200,000 grant awarded for Brisbane Community Pool energy upgrade**

I am delighted to announce I awarded the city of Brisbane a $200,000 grant in Measure K district-discretionary funds to replace the aging boiler at the community pool—a significant consumer of fossil fuels—with cutting-edge electric heat pump water heaters.

This project embodies a shared commitment to a healthier community and a cleaner, more sustainable future. This project was guided by the insights of the 2018 Zero Net Energy Study conducted in collaboration with the Bay Area Renewable Energy Network.

The transition to electric heat pump water heaters not only aligns with our environmental goals but also sets an example for other communities striving to reduce their carbon footprint.

It is through collaborative efforts that we can transform challenges into opportunities and create a lasting legacy of sustainability for generations to come.
---
| **Interns wanted to join our team ** We are looking to add to our great group of interns we are currently working with. If you or someone you know may be interested in applying to my Internship Program, submitting this form is the first step: [https://forms.gle/hiKqtn7Rird5vXwB9](https://davidcanepa.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c7592558e548bc8cc150aa5&id=fc71ba65df&e=c0babbc643). You can also reach out to Mike Richardson on my staff directly with any questions at [mrichardson@smcgov.org](mailto:mrichardson@smcgov.org). ** **
---
| **Battling food insecurity **
Food insecurity is a problem some residents may still face as we continue to emerge from the pandemic. Here are some resources residents can access: **CalFresh:**
Is a program for people with low-income who meet federal income eligibility rules and want to add to their budget to put healthy and nutritious food on the table. Website: [https://www.cdss.ca.gov/food-nutrition/calfresh](https://davidcanepa.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c7592558e548bc8cc150aa5&id=184fe70de3&e=c0babbc643) Contact: (650) 802-6576, [antorres@smcgov.org](mailto:antorres@smcgov.org) **Daly City Partnership:**
DC Partnership is a local partnership that was formed to guide collaborative efforts and connect our community to services that promote well-being. Check out their website for times and locations. Website: [https://www.dcpartnership.org/covid19/](https://davidcanepa.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c7592558e548bc8cc150aa5&id=042605366f&e=c0babbc643) **Second Harvest Food Bank:**
Second Harvest offers food at various locations throughout San Mateo County listed on its webpage. Website: [https://www.shfb.org/get-food/](https://davidcanepa.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c7592558e548bc8cc150aa5&id=3fbc5cecc3&e=c0babbc643) Contacts: Call (800) 984-3663 or text GETFOOD to (408) 455-5181 **Interns wanted to join our team **

We are looking to add to our great group of interns we are currently working with. If you or someone you know may be interested in applying to my Internship Program, submitting this form is the first step: [https://forms.gle/hiKqtn7Rird5vXwB9](https://davidcanepa.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c7592558e548bc8cc150aa5&id=e6aecc8f0e&e=c0babbc643). You can also reach out to Mike Richardson on my staff directly with any questions at [mrichardson@smcgov.org](mailto:mrichardson@smcgov.org) In friendship,
David J. Canepa

You may have seen the news that Democratic Sen. Joe Manchin is retiring from his seat in West Virginia. Unfortunately, his departure opens the door for a likely Republican pick-up of his Senate seat. That would bring our hard-won majority back to an even 50-50, with Vice President Kamala Harris as a tiebreaker. **Without a strong majority, our pro-choice agenda is at stake**. And we already know what Republicans will do if they flip enough seats: Pass a national abortion ban immediately.

So here's where EMILYs List (and you!) come in. We've endorsed pro-choice champion **Debbie Mucarsel-Powell** to flip a Senate seat in Florida, replacing anti-choice Sen. Rick Scott. Debbie winning this seat would keep Democrats in firm control of the Senate, _no matter what happens in West Virginia_.

**This is a must-win seat if we want to keep the Democratic majority in the Senate**. That's why we're opening up an opportunity to directly support Debbie's campaign today. Women are three times more likely to die during pregnancy in states with abortion bans |
# [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/73557641/438888581/-2095412496?refcode=AU_HTP_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20231117_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDYvMS8xMDI1NDMiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMjgwOTMwOGEtOTY4NS1lZTExLTg5MjUtMDAyMjQ4MzJlODExIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=G_H3bPb_dt8fctOjigTS7Eo6CMBp1N2QO2aJ-9e9uks=)

Peter, **Women are three times more likely to die during pregnancy in states with abortion bans.** Let’s say it again for the extremists in the back: ABORTION. IS. HEALTH. CARE. When you deny a woman the ability to make her own medical decisions, or have control over her own body, it puts her unnecessarily at risk. body:
Catching a killer | | |
---
[](http://links.rogersforsenate.com/u/click?_t=b90de78796ce4ce596523293a2b8ff82&_m=0b68a1d8744743adba6aa209e337a898&_e=qWTtyd_OdJTR0ZwjEJEhFtXNVamdFwfKFNUqOgpR-DNSLsaldyJ62yN5VLpHfI-ibj3YKIgjjEvv8SpMGpMRxYmQQE4LUHwr0ZzhjCuPoAR26qZgruN0Pefe_CGFk_Ti8PnJHQHsMlQNGh7ZzbrNwmih_kb_RHpyAug8IconHUUdQmO1VK8VhsSBIZIQwcnu4GUpT3jUnSwoMzs9KwPztVHczAPYMv5v1VvfZprJZv5hUsfTULKloEDPyqdOU8Zh2o4aCFijWhxsUSNXiACuyB84Lz-wSuGBkvH2cwdvaVBVjpNP9XCl2TXB1pwG2_r5TVwvyp8C0cgiXwrfhMqPJnzC4sQSPck5sAM_UFQA2bI9QfRp_Rgp-hOJ821lUX0SSIyKWF4SpSgPmMgiVdX0Cfcc1HaDS9SRDQGlXonTyic%3D)
---
Friend, There I was, sitting in my car about a block and a half down the street from an infamous Italian bakery. A bakery that had a mean maritozzo, but was infamous for other reasons.

You see, this is where some of the worst of the worst hung out. And I was there waiting for one man: A mafia capo named Johnny Apes. Why was he given this nickname? _Well, because he was known to go absolutely berserk ... excuse me, let’s just say — he was known to lose his temper and severely beat his lackeys. _ One wrong look in a meeting with Johnny Apes and he would lose his mind, and beat some of the members of his own family to a bloody pulp. _... At least, that was the word on the street._ Nevertheless, he was not the kind of guy that you wanted to mess with — and was suspected of killing north of 20 people. Chicago just could not afford to have Johnny Apes on their streets.

I was biding time with the radio turned all the way down and the driver-side window cracked about three or four inches to let a breeze in. I checked the area surrounding the bakery and saw nothing and was just about ready to call it a day.

Just as I went to put my key back in the ignition, there was movement. I quickly picked up my binoculars and saw the man that so many feared — Johnny Apes. It was like something out of a movie, this big, mean mob boss walking right down the middle of the street with a bald head, tinted-lensed glasses and a box of cannolis in tow.

So I moved in. I didn’t just want to bust this guy, I wanted to convince him to be an FBI informant. And as I riddled off all of the violent crimes the FBI knew that Johnny Apes had committed trying to persuade him, I’ll never forget the quick smirk he gave me, accompanied with one telling phrase: _“nothin’ like a good beating to keep the family together.”_

I share this story with one message: It might not be the mob or Johnny Apes anymore, but we absolutely have a huge crime issue on our streets again.

[With your help, I’ll take my knowledge from the FBI and United States Army training right to the halls of the Senate. ](http://links.rogersforsenate.com/u/click?_t=b90de78796ce4ce596523293a2b8ff82&_m=0b68a1d8744743adba6aa209e337a898&_e=qWTtyd_OdJTR0ZwjEJEhFtXNVamdFwfKFNUqOgpR-DNSLsaldyJ62yN5VLpHfI-ibj3YKIgjjEvv8SpMGpMRxYmQQE4LUHwr0ZzhjCuPoAR26qZgruN0Pefe_CGFk_Ti8PnJHQHsMlQNGh7ZzbrNwmih_kb_RHpyAug8IconHUUdQmO1VK8VhsSBIZIQwcnu4GUpT3jUnSwoMzs9KwPztVHczAPYMv5v1VvfZprJZv5hUsfTULKloEDPyqdOU8Zh2o4aCFijWhxsUSNXiACuyOAgdoZnbfutU4ChE5zsNQaBC25ZOjsNHxA5WfY3UkCPj58Zojl0_0BhnDh1kxL8A4pZuuLI99U6c6TuAdG2kOvCf5PEKDm9h57BOlskJUvL3PuQROW0K2dIaXj6Fw188yWO9Wvm3lhJ7guUh9UIA8Q%3D) The likes of Joe Biden and Chuck Schumer sure won’t — but I will work on **DAY ONE** to stop this crime epidemic. And let me tell you how:

1\. We **HAVE** to secure our Southern Border. Joe Biden is practically rolling out the red carpet for drug dealers, gang bangers, human traffickers and yes, even those on the FBI’s terror watchlist. clean_body: Catching a killer | | | Friend, There I was, sitting in my car about a block and a half down the street from an infamous Italian bakery. A bakery that had a mean maritozzo, but was infamous for other reasons. You see, this is where some of the worst of the worst hung out. And I was there waiting for one man: A mafia capo named Johnny Apes. Why was he given this nickname? Well, because he was known to go absolutely berserk ... excuse me, let’s just say — he was known to lose his temper and severely beat his lackeys. One wrong look in a meeting with Johnny Apes and he would lose his mind, and beat some of the members of his own family to a bloody pulp. ... At least, that was the word on the street. Nevertheless, he was not the kind of guy that you wanted to mess with — and was suspected of killing north of 20 people. Chicago just could not afford to have Johnny Apes on their streets. I was biding time with the radio turned all the way down and the driver-side window cracked about three or four inches to let a breeze in. I checked the area surrounding the bakery and saw nothing and was just about ready to call it a day. Just as I went to put my key back in the ignition, there was movement. I quickly picked up my binoculars and saw the man that so many feared — Johnny Apes. It was like something out of a movie, this big, mean mob boss walking right down the middle of the street with a bald head, tinted-lensed glasses and a box of cannolis in tow. So I moved in. I didn’t just want to bust this guy, I wanted to convince him to be an FBI informant. And as I riddled off all of the violent crimes the FBI knew that Johnny Apes had committed trying to persuade him, I’ll never forget the quick smirk he gave me, accompanied with one telling phrase: “nothin’ like a good beating to keep the family together.” I share this story with one message: It might not be the mob or Johnny Apes anymore, but we absolutely have a huge crime issue on our streets again. The likes of Joe Biden and Chuck Schumer sure won’t — but I will work on DAY ONE to stop this crime epidemic. And let me tell you how: 1\. We HAVE to secure our Southern Border. Joe Biden is practically rolling out the red carpet for drug dealers, gang bangers, human traffickers and yes, even those on the FBI’s terror watchlist. 2\. We MUST empower and support our nation’s law enforcement. No more peddling around with radical ideas like “defunding the police” or imposing cashless bail. 3\. We NEED to get back to PROSECUTING CRIMINALS to the fullest extent of the law again. If you do the crime, you do the time. I’m Mike Rogers — and I’ve helped take down some of the worst criminals this nation has ever seen. When I’m in the Senate, we’ll restore law and order to this country, and GET AMERICA BACK ON TRACK. Thank you, Mike Rogers Former FBI Agent & Candidate for U.S. Senate Paid for by Rogers for Senate.

clean_body: | | | You might have seen my note last week on behalf of my friends Sherrod Brown of Ohio and Bob Casey of Pennsylvania. I'm reaching out again to see if you can = to our campaigns. With the recent news of Democratic Senator Joe Manchin's retirement, Democrats now have no margin for error in the battle for the Senate. The unfortunate truth is that an open seat in West Virginia is effectively a pickup for the Republicans. This means they'd only need one more seat (such as Ohio or Pennsylvania) to capture the majority. I'm not about to let that happen. I know the fight ahead will be hard, but I'm confident that with strong grassroots support, we can bolster our incumbents in swing states across the country. Sherrod and Bob have been tireless champions for working families and our fundamental liberties, and I know they can prevail even in the face of heavy Republican spending. = Let's keep the Senate blue! Ron Forwarded Message | The side of freedom won big in Ohio and Pennsylvania this week — two bellwether states that will decide who controls the Senate next year. In Ohio, voters approved – by double-digit margins – ballot initiatives to secure reproductive rights and legalize marijuana. In Pennsylvania, Democrats significantly improved on their 2020 Presidential margins to win a key race for the State Supreme Court – which is likely to decide major cases in the years ahead on voting rights and choice. = Across the country this week, we saw Americans pushing back on the GOP's extremist agenda and its attempts to set our country back 70 years. The message was clear: when fundamental rights were on the ballots, voters chose the side pledging to protect those rights. The fights to protect bodily autonomy, ensure access to the ballot box, and improve our justice system are far from over. Republicans are going to be putting up extremists on those issues all across the country next year — and they've made clear that Ohio and Pennsylvania are among their top targets in their push to retake the Senate. Sherrod Brown, up for re-election in Ohio next year, and Bob Casey, up for re-election in Pennsylvania, stand with the clear majority of their constituents who want freedom to live their lives free from government intrusion. And with your help, we're going to make sure their messages overcome the waves of Republican misinformation and win out. Fellow American -

I’m still settling into my new office – both the physical space and the position I now hold in the federal government. I’m going to be honest with you, the last few weeks have been a blur – but productive and exciting as well.

body:
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/73558595/438891623/2130526953?refcode=emwrapper&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZTBjN2U4MDgtOWI4NS1lZTExLTg5MjUtMDAyMjQ4MzJlODExIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=QxUqd2GyH06GeDd_VZ-39bY_SBueDvmMluFZ9Mk2hVk=&emci=ed641002-9b85-ee11-8925-00224832e811&emdi=e0c7e808-9b85-ee11-8925-00224832e811&ceid=14016711)
Peter,
The need for well-intentioned, trustworthy journalism has _never been greater_.
With the 2024 election cycle starting, millions of Americans will be exposed to an endless torrent of election-related misinformation—with the overwhelming majority of this bad information coming from right-wing bad actors and other figures with a vested desire for Donald Trump to retake the White House next year.
**To make matters worse, Meta — the parent company of Facebook and Instagram recently announced that they will allow political ads claiming that the 2020 election was stolen.**
But Facebook isn’t alone. Their decision follows recent decisions from platforms like X (formerly known as Twitter), YouTube, and others — reversing policies put in place after the 2020 election and the January 6th insurrection to curb election disinformation.
**So _why_ exactly are these companies backtracking?**
**[We'll explain in just a moment, but if you want to help our network of nine newsrooms fight back against the latest front in America's information crisis, please consider chipping in $5 now.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/73558596/438891624/1796093817?refcode=em20231117&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZTBjN2U4MDgtOWI4NS1lZTExLTg5MjUtMDAyMjQ4MzJlODExIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=QxUqd2GyH06GeDd_VZ-39bY_SBueDvmMluFZ9Mk2hVk=)**
The short answer, Peter: money.
**But that’s not what Meta and other companies are saying.**
In an attempt to excuse the inexcusable, Facebook and others have claimed that they weighed the “free speech considerations” in coming to a final decision to “safeguard the ability to openly debate political ideas, even those that are controversial or based on disproven assumptions.”
**Here’s the thing. There’s a _real and dangerous cost_ to allowing disinformation like this to freely spread across the Internet, broadening its reach to millions nationwide.**
Rather than taking a firm stand against promoting disinformation, social media platforms like Facebook and mainstream media outlets are more concerned about their bottom line than protecting our democracy from dangerous conspiracy theories like the Big Lie.
It’s this reality that led to the creation of Courier. Unlike social media platforms and mainstream news organizations, **our priority has been _and will always be_ serving our communities and their residents with the accessible journalism** they need to make informed decisions, and that directly confronts right-wing disinformation at its source.
We’re not concerned about turning a profit or watering down our headlines for the sake of being “fair and balanced.” **Our mission to provide quality news across our nine newsrooms has never been more important.**
And unlike other mainstream news organizations, we’re powered by supporters like you, pitching in what they can, when they can.
[**Fighting bad information is a tall order, but we believe it's a necessary one if we're going to protect our democracy. Your support is key to ensuring Democracy's Newsroom has the resources it needs to continue fighting misinformation — in 2024 and beyond.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/73558597/438891625/1796093817?refcode=em20231117&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZTBjN2U4MDgtOWI4NS1lZTExLTg5MjUtMDAyMjQ4MzJlODExIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=QxUqd2GyH06GeDd_VZ-39bY_SBueDvmMluFZ9Mk2hVk=)

clean_body: Peter, The need for well-intentioned, trustworthy journalism has never been greater. With the 2024 election cycle starting, millions of Americans will be exposed to an endless torrent of election-related misinformation—with the overwhelming majority of this bad information coming from right-wing bad actors and other figures with a vested desire for Donald Trump to retake the White House next year. To make matters worse, Meta — the parent company of Facebook and Instagram recently announced that they will allow political ads claiming that the 2020 election was stolen. But Facebook isn’t alone. Their decision follows recent decisions from platforms like X (formerly known as Twitter), YouTube, and others — reversing policies put in place after the 2020 election and the January 6th insurrection to curb election disinformation. So why exactly are these companies backtracking? = The short answer, Peter: money. But that’s not what Meta and other companies are saying. In an attempt to excuse the inexcusable, Facebook and others have claimed that they weighed the “free speech considerations” in coming to a final decision to “safeguard the ability to openly debate political ideas, even those that are controversial or based on disproven assumptions.” Here’s the thing. There’s a real and dangerous cost to allowing disinformation like this to freely spread across the Internet, broadening its reach to millions nationwide. Rather than taking a firm stand against promoting disinformation, social media platforms like Facebook and mainstream media outlets are more concerned about their bottom line than protecting our democracy from dangerous conspiracy theories like the Big Lie. It’s this reality that led to the creation of Courier. Unlike social media platforms and mainstream news organizations, our priority has been and will always be serving our communities and their residents with the accessible journalism they need to make informed decisions, and that directly confronts right-wing disinformation at its source. We’re not concerned about turning a profit or watering down our headlines for the sake of being “fair and balanced.” Our mission to provide quality news across our nine newsrooms has never been more important. And unlike other mainstream news organizations, we’re powered by supporters like you, pitching in what they can, when they can. = = Thank you! Courier HQ Email us: mailto:info@couriernewsroom.com

name: Adam Schiff
subject: Eugene Vindman stood up for our democracy against Donald Trump. Now, it’s our turn to stand up for him:
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY VOTEVETS, VOTEVETS
body:
There are a lot of heroes who risked their careers to stand up for our democracy during the Donald Trump years. Eugene Vindman is most assuredly one of those real heroes.
#
[](https://act.votevets.org/go/2927?c0=vv-evfc-email-nov23.RfceN0&refcode=em231117-2-evfc-30&t=1&akid=19843%2E3013755%2EbxTMrR)
---
Derek -
There are a lot of heroes who risked their careers to stand up for our democracy during the Donald Trump years. **_Eugene Vindman is most assuredly one of those real heroes._**
Eugene raised the alarm, along with his twin brother Alexander, about Trump’s actions with Ukraine, leading to his impeachment. And when he did, he lost his White House job in retaliation.
Eugene stood up for what was right, even though it cost him dearly. Now he’s running for Congress in a swing district in Virginia, and needs your support.
**[If you don’t need to read anymore, and you’re ready to support Eugene Vindman’s campaign for Congress in Virginia, chip in $5 right now.](https://act.votevets.org/go/2927?c0=vv-evfc-email-nov23.RfceN0&refcode=em231117-2-evfc-30&t=2&akid=19843%2E3013755%2EbxTMrR)**
I first met Eugene when he accompanied his brother to testify before one of the House impeachment committee hearings I led. It wasn’t just Alex Vindman who blew the whistle, but Eugene as well.
Eugene was a Colonel in the U.S. Army, and assigned (like his twin brother) to the White House – a prestigious posting – as the senior ethics official at the National Security Council.
When he saw something that wasn’t ethical, that wasn’t right, and that harmed our national security, he raised the alarm.
Eugene had sworn an oath to protect and defend the Constitution. And even though his military career ended before its time, he never regretted doing the right thing. _Never._
That’s why Eugene Vindman is now running for Congress. To continue his patriotic service. To continue standing up for what’s right, and true.
Because since that perilous moment in our nation’s history when Eugene and Alex stood up to Trump, MAGA Republicans have only become more extreme and their attacks on our democracy more and more dangerous.
MAGA Republicans are now fully in charge of the House, and even picked Mike Johnson as their Speaker – the so-called “mastermind” behind their attempt to overturn the 2020 election.
We need elected leaders with integrity and a commitment to democracy on the frontlines in the House, and that’s why I’m endorsing Eugene Vindman for Congress in Virginia.
We need people who will honor their oath, and bring tenacity to the fight to protect all we hold dear. That's Eugene Vindman.
[**Please pitch in $5 to make his campaign for Congress successful. He has always stood up for our country and our constitution, and he will be amongst the very finest we will have serving in the House – but only with your help today.](https://act.votevets.org/go/2927?c0=vv-evfc-email-nov23.RfceN0&refcode=em231117-2-evfc-30&t=3&akid=19843%2E3013755%2EbxTMrR)**
Our democracy will depend on what we all do in the next few years. And I know that with Eugene Vindman in the House, we’ll have another champion on the frontlines.
Thanks for all you do,
Adam Schiff

name: Lauren Lalonde, Campaign Manager
subject: Getting ahead of the holiday slowdown
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Pramila for Congress
body:
For many campaigns, this time of year often means that fundraising numbers are lower than anticipated.
#
Hey Peter, it's Lauren — Pramila's Campaign Manager.
On the one hand, I'm excited that the holiday season is right around the corner. On the other hand,**I'm concerned because the holiday season often means slower fundraising for campaigns like ours**.
Look, I get it — around the holidays, folks are spending more time with their loved ones, enjoying the holiday season, living in the moment with not a phone in sight. But that also means they're checking their inboxes less, so _emails like these are_ _less likely to catch your attention._
So, while we gear up for the holiday festivities, we're also fortifying our campaign's plans to take on this potentially difficult season. It's my job to ensure that our campaign has the consistent tools, resources, and funds to keep up our momentum year-round.
**And** **Pramila is counting on us to show up for this movement and our progressive values.**
**Let's get ahead of the holiday fundraising slowdown together****, Peter.**[**Can we count on you to chip in $5, $10, $20, or whatever you're able to give to help us strengthen our campaign to keep Pramila in Congress?**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/47513?refcode=em20231117-3177&t=1&akid=3177%2E420207%2EHnRJwP)
